fields.label: Chat Theme
fields.description: Select the visual theme for the chat interface.

fields.label: Primary Color
fields.description: HEX color code for primary UI elements (e.g., #0073aa). Leave empty for default.

fields.label: User Message Bubble Color
fields.description: HEX color code for user message bubbles. Leave empty for default.

fields.label: Assistant Message Bubble Color
fields.description: HEX color code for assistant message bubbles. Leave empty for default.

fields.label: Border Radius (px)
fields.description: Border radius for chat bubbles in pixels. Higher values create more rounded corners.

fields.label: Font Size (px)
fields.description: Base font size for chat messages in pixels. Leave empty for default (14px).

fields.label: Show Timestamps
fields.description: Shows the time each message was sent below the message bubble.

fields.label: Show Avatars
fields.description: Shows avatar images next to messages in the chat interface.

fields.label: Compact Mode
fields.description: Reduces spacing between messages for a more condensed view.

fields.label: Max History Messages to Display
fields.description: Maximum number of messages to display in the chat history. Older messages will be collapsed.

fields.label: Message Animation Delay (ms)
fields.description: Delay in milliseconds for message appearance animation. Set to 0 to disable.

fields.label: Typing Indicator
fields.description: Displays animated "..." indicator when the assistant is processing a response.

fields.label: Auto-Scroll
fields.description: Automatically scrolls the chat window to show the latest message when new messages arrive.

fields.label: Markdown Rendering
fields.description: Allows rendering of markdown syntax (bold, italic, links, code blocks) in messages.

fields.label: Code Syntax Highlighting
fields.description: Applies syntax highlighting to code blocks in messages for better readability.

fields.label: Persist Chat History
fields.description: Automatically saves conversation history locally so users can resume their chats. History expires after 24 hours.

fields.label: Welcome Message
fields.description: Initial message displayed when chat loads. Leave empty to disable welcome message.

fields.label: Input Placeholder Text
fields.description: Placeholder text shown in the message input field.

fields.label: Send Button Text
fields.description: Text shown on the send button. Leave empty to use icon only.

fields.label: Show Usage Costs
fields.description: Shows small badges with total tokens and estimated cost (in USD) after each assistant response in the frontend chat. Helps users understand API usage and costs in real-time. Phase 7: Enhanced Token Tracking with Real-Time Cost Attribution.

fields.label: Show Capability Flags
fields.description: Shows badges indicating tool capabilities (e.g., "read-only", "external-api", "write", "local-only") after messages that use tools. Helps users understand what operations tools can perform.

fields.label: Copy Button
fields.description: Adds a copy button to each message, allowing users to copy message content to their clipboard.

fields.label: Save Button
fields.description: Allows users to save individual messages to their local storage for later reference.

fields.label: Delete Button
fields.description: Allows users to delete messages from their chat history.

fields.label: Text-to-Speech Button
fields.description: Adds a speech button to messages, allowing users to listen to assistant responses. Requires OpenAI TTS tool to be enabled.

fields.label: Voice Input (Transcription)
fields.description: Allows users to record voice messages that are transcribed to text. Requires OpenAI Whisper tool to be enabled.

fields.label: File Upload
fields.description: Allows users to upload files (images, documents) as attachments to their messages.

fields.label: Tool Shortcuts
fields.description: Displays quick access buttons for frequently used tools in the chat interface.

fields.label: Message Search
fields.description: Allows users to search through their chat history to find specific messages or topics.

fields.label: Export Conversation
fields.description: Allows users to export their conversation history to a downloadable file.

fields.label: Regenerate Response
fields.description: Allows users to request a new response from the assistant for the same query.

fields.label: Allowed File Types
fields.description: Comma-separated list of allowed file extensions (e.g., jpg,png,pdf,docx). Leave empty for default allowed types.

fields.label: Max File Size (MB)
fields.description: Maximum file size for uploads in megabytes. Set to 0 to use server default.

fields.label: Inline Image Optimization
fields.description: Images attached in chat and via document tools are sent to the provider as inline data (never a URL to download). When enabled, oversized JPEG/PNG images are downscaled to 2048px and opaque PNGs are re-encoded as JPEG so requests stay lean and vision token costs stay low. Transparent PNGs, animated GIFs, and WebP are left untouched; your original uploads are never modified.

fields.label: LLM Response Sanitization Level
fields.description: Controls how strictly LLM responses are sanitized before display in the chat client.

options.moderate: Moderate - Allow safe HTML, strip scripts and iframes
options.strict: Strict - Convert all HTML to plain text

fields.label: Max Response Length (characters)
fields.description: Maximum number of characters to display in a single LLM response. Longer responses will be truncated. Set to 0 for unlimited.

fields.label: Show 3 Result Buttons
fields.description: When enabled, shows 3 action buttons (e.g., Refine, Alternative, Expand) for each assistant response, allowing users to request variations of the answer.

fields.label: Result Button 1 Label
fields.description: Label for the first result action button. Default: "Refine"

fields.label: Result Button 1 Prompt
fields.description: System prompt sent to LLM when button 1 is clicked. Use {original_response} placeholder for the original message.

fields.label: Result Button 2 Label
fields.description: Label for the second result action button. Default: "Alternative"

fields.label: Result Button 2 Prompt
fields.description: System prompt sent to LLM when button 2 is clicked. Use {original_response} placeholder for the original message.

fields.label: Result Button 3 Label
fields.description: Label for the third result action button. Default: "Expand"

fields.label: Result Button 3 Prompt
fields.description: System prompt sent to LLM when button 3 is clicked. Use {original_response} placeholder for the original message.

fields.label: Enable Chat Bubble
fields.description: When enabled, a floating chat bubble will appear on every public page of your site, allowing visitors to open an AI chat panel. No widget or block placement is required.

fields.label: Chat Bubble Assistant
fields.description: The assistant to use for the chat bubble. Select "None (use default)" to fall back to the Default Assistant configured in General → Core Settings.

fields.label: Allow Guests
fields.description: When enabled, visitors who are not logged in can still use the chat bubble.

fields.label: Save Transcript
fields.description: When enabled, chat conversations will be saved server-side for later review.

fields.label: Enable Streaming
fields.description: When enabled, responses will appear word-by-word as they are generated.

fields.label: Allow Sensitive Tools
fields.description: When enabled, the assistant may use tools that modify data. Disable for a read-only experience.

fields.label: Chat Template
fields.description: Select the visual template for the chat interface inside the bubble panel.

fields.label: Bubble Position
fields.description: Where the floating chat bubble appears on the screen.

fields.label: Bubble Size
fields.description: Size of the floating chat bubble trigger button.

fields.label: Bubble Animation
fields.description: Animation effect for the chat bubble trigger button.

fields.label: Bubble Tooltip
fields.description: Tooltip text displayed when hovering over the chat bubble. Leave empty to disable.

fields.label: Panel Title
fields.description: Title displayed in the header of the chat panel.

fields.label: Panel Width (px)
fields.description: Width of the chat panel in pixels.

fields.label: Panel Height (px)
fields.description: Height of the chat panel in pixels.

fields.label: Auto-Open Delay (seconds)
fields.description: Automatically open the chat panel after this many seconds. Set to 0 to disable auto-open.

fields.label: Remember State
fields.description: When enabled, the bubble remembers its open/closed state across page navigations using localStorage.

fields.label: Notification Badge
fields.description: Displays a small notification dot on the bubble to attract attention.

fields.label: Bubble Color
fields.description: Background color of the chat bubble trigger button (HEX).

fields.label: Bubble Text/Icon Color
fields.description: Color of the icon and text inside the chat bubble trigger button (HEX).

fields.label: Panel Header Background
fields.description: Background color of the chat panel header (HEX). Leave empty to use bubble color.

fields.label: Panel Header Text Color
fields.description: Text color in the chat panel header (HEX).

fields.label: Exclude Pages
fields.description: Comma-separated list of page/post IDs where the chat bubble should NOT appear. Leave empty to show on all pages.

fields.label: Default Assistant
fields.description: The assistant used by default when one is not explicitly specified in REST API interactions. Leave as "None" to require explicit assistant selection.

fields.label: Extended Logging
fields.description: Raises the amount of context kept with each stored log entry, so larger request/response payloads and execution traces survive into the log views. Entries are still size-capped to protect the database, and assistant system prompts are always replaced with a length and hash fingerprint. Warning: this increases log size and may impact site performance. Only enable for short-term debugging.

fields.label: Agentic Loop Logging
fields.description: Logs each iteration of the agentic loop, including tool calls, tool results, and iteration timing. Useful for debugging assistant behavior and tool execution flow.

fields.label: API Request/Response Logging
fields.description: Logs API requests to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LM Studio and their responses. Helps debug API connectivity and response issues.

fields.label: Tool Execution Logging
fields.description: Logs each tool execution with arguments and results. Useful for debugging tool behavior and data flow.

fields.label: Chat Interaction Logging
fields.description: Logs complete chat interactions including user messages and assistant responses. Helps track conversation flow and debugging message handling.

fields.label: Debug Logging
fields.description: Writes debug-level events (high-frequency diagnostics such as skipped registrations) to the PHP error log. Very noisy — only enable for short-term debugging.

fields.label: Delete Data on Uninstall
fields.description: When enabled, all settings and data will be deleted when the plugin is uninstalled.

fields.label: Enable Activation Tracking
fields.description: When enabled, the plugin sends anonymous activation/deactivation events to NV Digital to help improve the product. Tracking is disabled by default — this requires your explicit consent. Only minimal, non-identifying data is collected: plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version, and a hashed site ID. No personal information or IP addresses are collected. Learn more about what data is collected

fields.label: Max History Messages
fields.description: Maximum number of previous messages to include in chat context. Higher values provide more context but increase token usage.

fields.label: Context Strategy
fields.description: Sliding Window: keeps only the most recent messages. BME: summarizes older messages and keeps recent ones verbatim. BME+RAG: adds memory retrieval for cross-session context.

fields.label: End Window Size
fields.description: Number of recent messages to keep verbatim in the End zone. Older messages will be summarized. Only used with BME strategy.

fields.label: Summary Trigger Count
fields.description: When total non-system messages exceed this count, older messages are summarized. Only used with BME strategy.

fields.label: Summary Trigger Tokens
fields.description: Alternative token-based trigger. When set (>0), summarization triggers at 80% of this value instead of using count. Set to 0 to use count-based trigger.

fields.label: Summary Model
fields.description: Model to use for conversation summarization. Leave blank to use the assistant model. Use a faster/cheaper model for cost-efficient summaries.

fields.label: Summary Max Tokens
fields.description: Maximum tokens for the generated conversation summary. Higher values preserve more detail.

fields.label: Tool Result Summarize Threshold
fields.description: Tool results longer than this many characters will be truncated before storing in chat history. Set to 0 to disable.

fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: How long to wait for AI provider responses before timing out. Increase for complex requests or slower providers.

fields.label: Max Posts Query Results
fields.description: Maximum number of posts returned by content query tools such as Get Recent Posts and Search Content. Increase this to allow AI tools to retrieve more posts per query. Default: 50.

fields.label: Background Hand-off (seconds)
fields.description: How long a chat stream may go silent — while a tool or non-streamed model call runs — before the remaining turn is handed to the background worker. This is a proxy idle limit, not the AI provider timeout. The default 110 sits just under Cloudflare's 125 s origin read timeout, leaving a margin for the hand-off to arrive; lower it if your proxy resets sooner (AWS load balancers and a default nginx proxy_read_timeout reset at 60 s). It must stay below your proxy limit — at or above it the connection is already gone when the check fires. Set to 0 to disable hand-off.

fields.label: Default Light Model
fields.description: Default AI model for simple tasks. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_default_light_model filter. Default: gpt-4o-mini

fields.label: Default Advanced Model
fields.description: Default AI model for complex tasks. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_default_advanced_model filter. Default: gpt-4.1

fields.label: Max Agentic Iterations
fields.description: Maximum number of tool execution loops per request. Prevents infinite loops. Range: 1-50. Default: 5

fields.label: Resource Max Tokens
fields.description: Maximum tokens for AI responses based on workload tier. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_resource_max_tokens filter. Leave empty for auto-detection.

fields.label: Resource Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Request timeout based on workload tier. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_resource_request_timeout filter. Leave empty for auto-detection.

fields.label: Max Retries
fields.description: Maximum retry attempts for failed API requests. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_max_retries filter. Default: 3

fields.label: Max Retry Delay (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum delay between retry attempts. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_max_retry_delay filter. Default: 60

fields.label: Max Attachment Size (bytes)
fields.description: Maximum size for file attachments in chat. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_max_attachment_bytes filter. Default: 10485760 (10MB)

fields.label: Default Ollama Endpoint URL
fields.description: Default endpoint URL for Ollama local AI. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_default_ollama_endpoint_url filter. Default: http://localhost:11434

fields.label: Default LM Studio Endpoint URL
fields.description: Default endpoint URL for LM Studio local AI. Overrides the wp_mcp_ai_default_lm_studio_endpoint_url filter. Default: http://localhost:1234

fields.label: Enable Automatic Provider Failover
fields.description: When enabled, the system tracks provider health in real-time. If the primary AI provider returns errors (5xx, rate-limit, timeout), the request is automatically retried on the next healthy provider in the priority order. This may increase API costs if fallback providers have different pricing.

fields.label: Enable OpenAI Provider
fields.description: When disabled, OpenAI will not be available for use by assistants or API requests.

fields.label: OpenAI API Key Type
fields.description: Select your OpenAI subscription tier. This helps the plugin optimize request handling and rate limits. Standard is for pay-as-you-go API keys. Business/Team and Enterprise keys may have different rate limits and project scoping.

fields.label: OpenAI Embedding Model
fields.description: Model to use for generating text embeddings. text-embedding-3-small offers the best balance of performance and cost. text-embedding-3-large provides higher accuracy for complex tasks.

fields.label: OpenAI Organization ID (Optional)
fields.description: Your OpenAI organization ID if you belong to multiple organizations. Sent as the OpenAI-Organization header with every request. Find it in your OpenAI account settings.

fields.label: OpenAI Project ID (Optional)
fields.description: Your OpenAI project ID for project-scoped API access. Sent as the OpenAI-Project header to scope usage, billing, and access. Recommended for Business and Enterprise accounts. Find it in your OpenAI project settings.

fields.label: OpenAI API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for OpenAI API requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://api.openai.com/v1). Useful for enterprise proxy endpoints, Azure OpenAI, or OpenAI-compatible services. Must include the version path (e.g. /v1).

fields.label: OpenAI Image Model
fields.description: Default model for image generation via OpenAI. gpt-image-2 (Images 2.0, April 2026) is the current state-of-the-art with native 2K resolution, multi-image coherency, and near-flawless multilingual text rendering. gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-1, and gpt-image-1-mini are previous generations. DALL-E 2 and DALL-E 3 were deprecated and removed from the API on May 12, 2026.

fields.label: OpenAI Image Size
fields.description: Default size for generated images. 1024x1024 works for all models. 2048-pixel sizes (2K) require gpt-image-2.

fields.label: OpenAI Image Quality
fields.description: Default quality setting for image generation. For gpt-image models: low is faster/cheaper, medium balances quality and cost, high provides best results. Auto lets the model decide.

fields.label: OpenAI Image Response Format
fields.description: Format for receiving generated images from OpenAI. b64_json returns base64-encoded data directly (recommended). URL provides a hosted image link (expires after 1 hour).

fields.label: OpenAI Transcription Model
fields.description: Default model for audio transcription. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe is the current recommended default offering superior accuracy. gpt-4o-transcribe provides highest quality. whisper-1 is the legacy Whisper model.

fields.label: OpenAI Transcription Response Format
fields.description: Default format for transcription responses. verbose_json includes timestamps and metadata, json returns text only.

fields.label: OpenAI Transcription Language (Optional)
fields.description: Optional ISO-639-1 language code (e.g., "en" for English, "es" for Spanish) to hint the language of the audio. Leave empty for automatic detection.

fields.label: OpenAI Transcription Temperature (Optional)
fields.description: Optional sampling temperature between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. Leave empty to use default.

fields.label: OpenAI Text-to-Speech Model
fields.description: Default model for text-to-speech (TTS) generation. gpt-4o-mini-tts is the current recommended model with natural speech and voice presets. Note: OpenAI deprecates the TTS models on January 6, 2027 in favour of gpt-realtime-2.1-mini (Realtime API). tts-1 and tts-1-hd are legacy models.

fields.label: OpenAI Text-to-Speech Voice
fields.description: Default voice for text-to-speech generation. Each voice has a distinct personality and tone. Preview voices at OpenAI documentation.

fields.label: OpenAI Text-to-Speech Format
fields.description: Audio output format for TTS. MP3 offers best compatibility. OPUS is most efficient. AAC works well on Apple devices. FLAC is lossless quality. WAV is uncompressed.

fields.label: Enable Voice Activity Detection (VAD)
fields.description: When enabled, voice chat automatically stops recording and sends your message after detecting a pause in your speech (700ms of silence). This provides a hands-free experience. You can still manually stop recording anytime.

fields.label: VAD Silence Threshold (milliseconds)
fields.description: How long to wait after detecting silence before auto-stopping recording. Industry standard: 700ms. Lower values (500ms) are more responsive but may cut off pauses. Higher values (1000ms+) give more time for thinking.

fields.label: VAD Minimum Speech Duration (milliseconds)
fields.description: Minimum amount of speech required before VAD can auto-stop. Prevents false triggers from quick sounds. Recommended: 300ms.

fields.label: VAD Audio Level Threshold (dB)
fields.description: Audio level threshold for detecting speech vs silence. Default: -50dB. Lower values (e.g., -60dB) are more sensitive and detect quieter speech. Higher values (e.g., -40dB) require louder speech and ignore more background noise.

fields.label: Enable High Token Model Switch
fields.description: When enabled, if a request exceeds the current model's token limit, the system will automatically switch to the specified fallback model with higher capacity. This prevents errors and ensures requests are processed even with large contexts.

fields.label: High Token Fallback Model (Global)
fields.description: Global fallback model used when a provider-specific fallback is not configured. Should be a model with higher token capacity than your default. This setting applies when no per-provider fallback is set.

fields.label: OpenAI Fallback Model
fields.description: Default fallback model for OpenAI. When an OpenAI model exceeds its token limit, the system switches to this model. Leave empty to use the global fallback.

fields.label: Enable OpenAI API Response Caching
fields.description: When enabled, caches model lists and embedding responses to reduce API calls and improve performance. Only deterministic operations are cached (chat completions are never cached).

fields.label: OpenAI Model List Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache the OpenAI model list. Model lists rarely change, so longer caching is recommended. Default: 12 hours (43200 seconds).

fields.label: OpenAI Embedding Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache embedding responses. Embeddings are deterministic (same input = same output), so longer caching is safe. Default: 24 hours (86400 seconds).

fields.label: Enable Anthropic Provider
fields.description: When disabled, Anthropic will not be available for use by assistants or API requests.

fields.label: Anthropic API Key Type
fields.description: Select your Anthropic subscription tier. This helps the plugin optimize request handling and rate limits. Standard is for pay-as-you-go API keys. Team and Enterprise keys have workspace-level billing and access controls.

fields.label: Default Anthropic Model
fields.description: The default Claude model to use for Anthropic requests. Claude Sonnet 4.6 offers the best balance of intelligence and speed. Claude Haiku 4.5 is faster and more economical for simpler tasks.

fields.label: Anthropic Vision Model
fields.description: Default model for image analysis and vision tasks via Anthropic. All Claude 4.x models support vision capabilities. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.6 offer the best vision performance.

fields.label: Anthropic Max Image Tokens
fields.description: Maximum number of tokens to allocate for image analysis. Higher values allow more detailed analysis but use more tokens. Leave empty to use model defaults. Typical range: 1000-4000.

fields.label: Anthropic Fallback Model
fields.description: Default fallback model for Anthropic. When a Claude model exceeds its token limit, the system switches to this model. Leave empty to use the global fallback.

fields.label: Enable Anthropic API Response Caching
fields.description: When enabled, caches model lists and other deterministic API responses to reduce API calls and improve performance. Chat completions are never cached.

fields.label: Anthropic Model List Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache the Anthropic model list. Model lists rarely change, so longer caching is recommended. Default: 12 hours (43200 seconds).

fields.label: Anthropic API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for Anthropic API requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://api.anthropic.com/v1). Useful for enterprise proxy endpoints or Anthropic-compatible services. Must include the version path (e.g. /v1).

fields.label: Enable Gemini Provider
fields.description: When disabled, Gemini will not be available for use by assistants or API requests.

fields.label: Gemini API Key Type
fields.description: Select your Google Gemini subscription tier. This helps the plugin optimize request handling and rate limits. Standard is for AI Studio pay-as-you-go keys. Enterprise keys may use Vertex AI endpoints with higher limits and compliance features.

fields.label: Default Gemini Model
fields.description: The default model to use for Gemini requests. Gemini 3.8 Flash is the latest stable generation (September 2026). Gemini 2.5 Flash / 2.5 Pro remain available for existing users but Google limits new projects to the 3.x line.

fields.label: Gemini Fallback Model
fields.description: Default fallback model for Gemini. When a Gemini model exceeds its token limit, the system switches to this model. Leave empty to use the global fallback.

fields.label: Gemini Thinking Budget (tokens)
fields.description: Maximum thinking tokens for Gemini 3.x extended reasoning (thinkingConfig). Set to 0 to disable. Recommended: 1024–8192 for most tasks, up to 24576 for complex reasoning. Only affects models that support extended thinking (e.g. gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-4-argon).

fields.label: Gemini Image Model
fields.description: Default model for image generation via Gemini. gemini-nano-banana-2.1 (Nano Banana 2.1, October 2026 GA) is the latest specialized image generation model with improved visual quality, multi-turn character consistency, text rendering, and wide/panoramic ratios (1:4/4:1/1:8/8:1). gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2) was deprecated on October 6, 2026 (no shutdown date announced).

fields.label: Gemini Image MIME Type
fields.description: Default image format for Gemini-generated images. PNG offers lossless compression, JPEG is smaller for photos, WebP provides best compression.

fields.label: Gemini Image Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Default aspect ratio for Gemini-generated images. Square (1:1) works for most purposes. Portrait (3:4, 9:16) and landscape (4:3, 16:9) offer creative flexibility.

fields.label: Gemini Video Model
fields.description: Default model for video generation via Gemini. gemini-omni-1.1-flash (August 2026) is the current any-to-any multimodal model replacing Veo — supports text/images/audio/video → video, 10s duration, native audio, multi-turn conversational editing. Veo 3.1 previews shut down October 22, 2026.

fields.label: Gemini Video Resolution
fields.description: Default resolution for Gemini-generated videos. 720p is supported by all models and works for all aspect ratios. 1080p requires Omni Flash or Veo 3.1, 16:9 aspect ratio, and exactly 8 seconds duration. Note: Veo 2.0 always outputs 720p regardless of this setting.

fields.label: Gemini Video Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Default aspect ratio for Gemini-generated videos. 16:9 is landscape/widescreen format (supports both 720p and 1080p). 9:16 is vertical/portrait format (supports 720p only).

fields.label: Gemini Video Duration
fields.description: Default duration for Gemini-generated videos in seconds. Gemini Omni Flash supports up to 10 seconds (native audio included). Veo 3.1 supports 4-8 seconds, Veo 2.0 supports 5-8 seconds. Note: If 1080p resolution is requested, duration will be automatically set to 8 seconds (API requirement).

fields.label: Enable Gemini Omni Flash API
fields.description: Omni Flash (May 2026) is the next-gen video model replacing Veo — 10s duration, native audio, multi-turn conversational editing, up to 5 reference images. When disabled, Veo 3.1 is used as fallback for all video generation. Note: Omni API access is rolling out gradually; if you encounter errors, disable this toggle and Veo 3.1 will be used automatically.

fields.label: Enable Gemini API Response Caching
fields.description: When enabled, caches model lists, token counts, and embedding responses to reduce API calls and improve performance. Only deterministic operations are cached (chat completions are never cached).

fields.label: Gemini Model List Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache the Gemini model list. Model lists rarely change, so longer caching is recommended. Default: 12 hours (43200 seconds).

fields.label: Gemini Embedding Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache embedding responses. Embeddings are deterministic (same input = same output), so longer caching is safe. Default: 24 hours (86400 seconds).

fields.label: Gemini Token Count Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache token counting results. Token counts are deterministic for the same input and model. Default: 1 hour (3600 seconds).

fields.label: Gemini Audio Language Code
fields.description: Default language code for Google Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech (e.g., "en-US", "es-ES", "fr-FR"). Supports 125+ languages.

fields.label: Gemini Speech Voice
fields.description: Default voice for Google Text-to-Speech. Neural2 voices provide improved quality. Choose based on desired gender and language.

fields.label: Gemini API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for Gemini API requests. Leave empty to use the default Google AI Studio endpoint. Useful for Vertex AI Enterprise deployments with custom regional endpoints or proxy services. Must include the version path (e.g. /v1beta).

fields.label: Enable Higgsfield Provider
fields.description: Higgsfield (higgsfield.ai) is an AI-native creative suite exposing a curated catalog of 50+ video and image models through one asynchronous API. Disabled by default; enable after adding your API credentials.

fields.label: Higgsfield API Key ID
fields.description: Your Higgsfield API key ID (first half of the two-part credential). Create credentials in the Higgsfield Console. You can also set the HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_ID environment variable. The key is shown only once at creation.

fields.label: Higgsfield API Key Secret
fields.description: Your Higgsfield API key secret (second half of the two-part credential). Requests authenticate with "Key {ID}:{Secret}". You can also set the HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_SECRET environment variable. Keep this value server-side — never expose it in browser or mobile code.

fields.label: Higgsfield Video Resolution
fields.description: Default resolution for Higgsfield Cinema Studio videos.

fields.label: Higgsfield Video Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Default aspect ratio for Higgsfield Cinema Studio videos.

fields.label: Higgsfield Video Duration
fields.description: Default duration for Higgsfield Cinema Studio videos in seconds (4-30). Video is billed per second of output from your prepaid balance.

fields.label: Generate Audio with Higgsfield Videos
fields.description: When enabled, Higgsfield Cinema Studio generates a soundtrack with the video. Disable for silent clips.

fields.label: Enable Ollama Provider
fields.description: When disabled, Ollama will not be available for use by assistants or API requests. Disabled by default because Ollama requires a separately installed local server; enable after configuring your endpoint URL and pulling at least one model.

fields.label: Ollama Model
fields.description: The model name to use with Ollama. Must match exactly a model you have pulled (e.g., llama3, mistral, codellama). Use \"ollama list\" in terminal to see available models.

fields.label: Ollama Network Interface (Optional)
fields.description: Advanced: Bind HTTP requests to a specific LOCAL network interface on THIS WordPress server. Examples: "eth0", "wlan0", or a LOCAL IP like "192.168.1.50" assigned to THIS server. Leave EMPTY for most setups (default routing works). NOTE: If your Ollama is on a different machine (e.g., 192.168.2.100), put that IP in the Endpoint URL field above, NOT here. This field is for source binding only.

fields.label: Enable Ollama API Response Caching
fields.description: When enabled, caches model lists and embedding responses to reduce API calls and improve performance. Uses shorter TTLs since Ollama is local. Only deterministic operations are cached (chat completions are never cached).

fields.label: Ollama Model List Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache the Ollama model list. Since Ollama is local, shorter caching is sufficient. Default: 5 minutes (300 seconds).

fields.label: Ollama Embedding Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache embedding responses. Embeddings are deterministic (same input = same output), so longer caching is safe. Default: 24 hours (86400 seconds).

fields.label: Enable LM Studio Provider
fields.description: When disabled, LM Studio will not be available for use by assistants or API requests. Disabled by default because LM Studio requires a separately installed local server; enable after configuring your endpoint URL and loading a model.

fields.label: LM Studio Endpoint URL
fields.description: URL where your LM Studio server is running. Examples: "http://localhost:1234" (same machine), "http://192.168.2.222:1234" (private network). For remote WordPress (e.g., Cloudways) connecting to private LAN LM Studio: ensure network routing/VPN is configured, then enter the private IP. The plugin handles SSL verification and connection timeouts automatically.

fields.label: LM Studio Model
fields.description: The model identifier for your loaded LM Studio model. This is typically shown in the LM Studio interface. Some installations accept \"local-model\" as a generic identifier.

fields.label: LM Studio Network Interface (Optional)
fields.description: Advanced: Bind HTTP requests to a specific LOCAL network interface on THIS WordPress server. Examples: "eth0", "wlan0", or a LOCAL IP like "192.168.1.50" assigned to THIS server. Leave EMPTY for most setups (default routing works). NOTE: If your LM Studio is on a different machine (e.g., 192.168.2.222), put that IP in the Endpoint URL field above, NOT here. This field is for source binding only.

fields.label: LM Studio API Key (Optional)
fields.description: Optional bearer token for LM Studio authentication (LM Studio 0.3.6+). Leave empty if your server does not require authentication.

fields.label: Use LM Studio Native API (/api/v0)
fields.description: When enabled, model listing uses /api/v0/models which returns architecture, quantization, loaded context size, and per-model capability flags. Chat completions use /api/v0/chat/completions which returns performance stats (tokens/sec, TTFT). Default: off (uses /v1 for full backwards compatibility).

fields.label: Enable Hugging Face Provider
fields.description: When disabled, Hugging Face will not be available for use by assistants or API requests.

fields.label: Hugging Face API Key
fields.description: Your Hugging Face API token. Get one from Hugging Face Settings. Use a token with "Inference" permissions. You can also set the HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY environment variable or configure this key in Settings → Connectors (WP 7.0+).

fields.label: Hugging Face Endpoint URL
fields.description: URL for the Hugging Face Inference API. Use the default for the public API, or provide a custom endpoint URL for Inference Endpoints or private deployments. The plugin automatically appends the correct path (/chat/completions or /models).

fields.label: Hugging Face Model
fields.description: The model identifier to use with Hugging Face. Examples: "meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct", "mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3", "microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct". Must be a chat/instruction model with a chat_template defined.

fields.label: Hugging Face Audio Model
fields.description: Model identifier for audio transcription. Default is "openai/whisper-large-v3" which provides high-quality multilingual transcription via Hugging Face Inference API.

fields.label: Enable HuggingFace Dataset Viewer
fields.description: When enabled, AI assistants can query 100,000+ machine learning datasets from HuggingFace Hub without downloading them. Useful for dataset discovery, preview, search, and filtering for few-shot learning.

fields.label: HuggingFace API Token (Optional)
fields.description: Optional: Only required for accessing private or gated datasets. Public datasets work without a token. Get one from HuggingFace Settings.

fields.label: Cache TTL (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache dataset API responses. Longer values reduce API calls but may show stale data. Range: 60-86400 seconds (1 minute to 24 hours).

fields.label: Default Row Limit
fields.description: Default number of rows to return when previewing datasets. Maximum 100 rows per request. Lower values reduce token usage.

fields.label: Enable Cloudflare Workers AI Provider
fields.description: When disabled, Cloudflare Workers AI will not be available for use by assistants or API requests.

fields.label: Cloudflare Account ID
fields.description: Your Cloudflare account ID. Find this in your Cloudflare Dashboard under Workers & Pages > Overview.

fields.label: Default Cloudflare Model
fields.description: The default model to use for Cloudflare Workers AI requests. Llama 4 Scout 17B is the current recommended default with function calling support.

fields.label: Default Cloudflare Image Model
fields.description: The default model to use for Cloudflare Workers AI text-to-image generation. Flux-2 Dev offers the best balanced quality. Flux-1 Schnell is fastest. SDXL models are legacy options.

fields.label: Default Image Width
fields.description: Default width for generated images in pixels (256-2048). Different models may have different optimal sizes.

fields.label: Default Image Height
fields.description: Default height for generated images in pixels (256-2048). Different models may have different optimal sizes.

fields.label: Default Number of Steps
fields.description: Default number of diffusion steps (1-20). More steps can improve quality but take longer. 20 is recommended.

fields.label: Default Guidance Scale
fields.description: Default guidance scale controls how closely the image follows the prompt. Higher values (7-15) mean stricter adherence. 7.5 is recommended.

fields.label: Enable Cloudflare API Response Caching
fields.description: When enabled, caches model lists and other deterministic API responses to reduce API calls and improve performance. Chat completions and image generations are never cached.

fields.label: Cloudflare Model List Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long to cache the Cloudflare Workers AI model list. Model lists rarely change, so longer caching is recommended. Default: 12 hours (43200 seconds).

fields.label: Cloudflare STT Model
fields.description: Speech-to-Text model for audio transcription. Whisper provides standard transcription. Deepgram Flux offers advanced features with turn detection for conversational AI.

fields.label: Enable NVIDIA NIM Provider
fields.description: When disabled, NVIDIA NIM will not be available for use by assistants or API requests.

fields.label: NVIDIA API Key
fields.description: Your NVIDIA NIM API key. Get one from NVIDIA Build Portal. Sign up for an NVIDIA account and generate an API key for NIM access. You can also set the NVIDIA_API_KEY environment variable.

fields.label: NVIDIA NIM Endpoint URL
fields.description: The base URL for the NVIDIA NIM API. Use the default cloud endpoint or point to a self-hosted NIM container (e.g., http://localhost:8000/v1).

fields.label: Default NVIDIA Model
fields.description: The default model to use for NVIDIA NIM requests. Llama 3.1 8B is fast and cost-effective. Llama 3.3 70B offers better quality. Browse all models at build.nvidia.com.

fields.label: Enable DeepSeek Provider
fields.description: When disabled, DeepSeek will not be available for use by assistants or API requests.

fields.label: DeepSeek API Key
fields.description: Your DeepSeek API key. Get one from DeepSeek Platform. The same key works for all DeepSeek models. You can also set the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable.

fields.label: Default DeepSeek Model
fields.description: The default DeepSeek model to use. deepseek-flash (V4.1 Flash: 1M context, 384K output, native vision) is the recommended general-purpose model supporting both non-thinking and thinking modes. deepseek-v4-pro remains available — DeepSeek continues V4 Pro service past September 14, 2026 with unchanged billing until further notice. Legacy models (chat, reasoner, coder, V4 Flash) are retired from the API.

fields.label: DeepSeek API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for DeepSeek API requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://api.deepseek.com). Useful for regional proxies (e.g., Volcano Engine) or DeepSeek-compatible services. Note: DeepSeek bills peak rates during 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC weekdays; all other hours are off-peak (half price).

fields.label: Enable OpenRouter Provider
fields.description: OpenRouter is a unified gateway in front of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral and many other providers — all reachable through a single API key with OpenAI-compatible requests.

fields.label: OpenRouter API Key
fields.description: Your OpenRouter API key. Get one from OpenRouter Keys. The same key works for every model in the OpenRouter catalogue. You can also set the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.

fields.label: Default OpenRouter Model
fields.description: The default model to use for OpenRouter requests. Use the namespaced form, e.g. "openai/gpt-4o-mini" or "anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet". Pick "openrouter/auto" to let OpenRouter choose a recommended model on each request.

fields.label: OpenRouter API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for OpenRouter API requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1). Useful when proxying OpenRouter through your own gateway.

fields.label: Site URL (HTTP-Referer)
fields.description: OpenRouter sends this value in the HTTP-Referer header to identify your application on its leaderboard and dashboard. Leave empty to use this site's home URL.

fields.label: Application Title (X-Title)
fields.description: OpenRouter sends this value in the X-Title header to label requests in its dashboard. Leave empty to use this site's title.

fields.label: Enable TypeSafe Provider
fields.description: TypeSafe Jev is a decision model, not a chat model: it returns typed, probabilistic decisions (choice / score / yes-no) about supplied state. It powers the typesafe_decide tool and decision surfaces. Billing is input-only ($0.042 per million input tokens, output free).

fields.label: TypeSafe API Key
fields.description: Your TypeSafe API key. Early access keys are issued at console.typesafe.ai (waitlisted). You can also set the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable. Alternatively, leave this empty and use your OpenRouter key with the typesafe_decide tool's openrouter transport.

fields.label: Default TypeSafe Model
fields.description: The default Jev model for decision requests. "jev-latest" follows TypeSafe's newest release — pin an explicit version such as jev-1.13.0 when you tune confidence thresholds, because answers can change under the moving alias.

fields.label: TypeSafe API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for TypeSafe API requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://api.typesafe.ai). Useful when proxying through your own gateway.

fields.label: TypeSafe API Endpoint Path (Optional)
fields.description: Custom endpoint path relative to the base URL. Leave empty to use the default (/v1/systemone). Third-party gateways and resellers may serve Jev on a different route (e.g. /v1/decisions) — verify their terms before switching.

fields.label: Cache TypeSafe Decisions
fields.description: Identical (model, state, questions) requests are served from a short-lived transient cache at zero cost and marked cached: true in the response. Decisions are advisory — the cache is never used to gate state-changing operations. Default TTL 5 minutes (filter: wp_mcp_ai_typesafe_cache_ttl).

fields.label: Jev Research Source Filtering
fields.description: Pro research tools (research_eca, generate_research_report) will ask Jev to score and drop clearly irrelevant search sources before generating their reports, keeping the most relevant sources first. Fails open when Jev is unreachable.

fields.label: Jev Guest-Chat Guardrail
fields.description: With the Pro addon, every chat message is screened against the Jev hazard set (prompt injection, harassment, self-harm, sensitive PII, illegal activity) before it reaches the model. Only a high-confidence block verdict vetoes the message; review verdicts pass through advisory. Fails open when Jev is unreachable or unconfigured.

fields.label: Jev Citation Checking
fields.description: Pro research tools (research_eca, generate_research_report) ask Jev whether each cited source passage supports the claim it is cited for, and attach the checks to the report envelope. Fails open — on any error the checks are simply omitted.

fields.label: Jev Citation Escalation
fields.description: With the Pro addon and Jev Citation Checking enabled, each claim whose cited source fails to support it is verified with a two-question Jev battery, then revised once by the verification-tier model so it is strictly supported. Single escalation per claim, capped at 3 revisions per report (filter: wp_mcp_ai_citation_escalation_max). Fails open — any error keeps the original claim.

fields.label: Jev Tier-Routing Signal
fields.description: With the Pro addon, the first user message of a chat request is classified by Jev (task type, complexity, frontier need) and the result feeds the orchestration depth scheduler and tiered model selection as a semantic confidence signal. Jev never picks a model directly — every threshold stays in code, and an uncertain decision (complexity confidence below 0.5) falls back to the neutral default. Only the first user message is sent, never tool results or transcripts. Fails open when Jev is unreachable or unconfigured.

fields.label: Enable DigitalOcean Provider
fields.description: DigitalOcean Serverless Inference exposes Llama, DeepSeek-R1 distill, OpenAI gpt-oss, and other open-weights models through an OpenAI-compatible REST API at https://inference.do-ai.run/v1.

fields.label: DigitalOcean Model Access Key
fields.description: Your DigitalOcean Serverless Inference model access key. Create one from Gradient Platform → Serverless Inference → Model access keys. Keys can be scoped to specific models, inference routers, or batch jobs. You can also set the DIGITALOCEAN_API_KEY environment variable.

fields.label: Default DigitalOcean Model
fields.description: The default model to use for DigitalOcean Serverless Inference requests (e.g. "llama3.3-70b-instruct" or "deepseek-r1-distill-llama-70b"). Available models change as DigitalOcean adds new ones — the list refreshes from the /v1/models endpoint when an API key is configured.

fields.label: DigitalOcean API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for DigitalOcean Serverless Inference requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://inference.do-ai.run/v1). Useful when proxying through your own gateway or VPC endpoint.

fields.label: DigitalOcean Embedding Model (Optional)
fields.description: Embedding model id used when DigitalOcean is selected as the embedding provider. Defaults to "gte-large-en-v1.5".

fields.label: Enable Kimi Provider
fields.description: Kimi is Moonshot AI's OpenAI-compatible large language model family. kimi-k3 (July 2026) is the 2.8T-parameter flagship with 1M context; kimi-k2.6/k2.7-code remain available. The kimi-k2.5/kimi-k2/moonshot-v1 lines were discontinued in 2026.

fields.label: Kimi API Key
fields.description: Your Moonshot AI (Kimi) API key. Get one from Moonshot AI Platform. The same key works for all Kimi / Moonshot models. You can also set the KIMI_API_KEY environment variable.

fields.label: Default Kimi Model
fields.description: The default Kimi model to use. kimi-k3.1-pro is the current flagship with 1M context and vision (recommended). kimi-k2.7-code is the coding specialist; kimi-k2.6 is the stable 256K agentic model. The K2 series retires at the end of December 2026.

options.kimi-k3.1-pro: Kimi K3.1 Pro (3T MoE, 1M Context, Recommended)

fields.label: Kimi API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for Kimi API requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://api.moonshot.ai/v1). Useful for regional proxies or Kimi-compatible endpoints.

fields.label: Enable Baseten Provider
fields.description: Baseten Model APIs offer managed access to open-source LLMs (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi) through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with optimized serving. Tool calling and structured outputs supported.

fields.label: Baseten API Key
fields.description: Your Baseten API key. Create one from Baseten API Keys. The same key works for all models in the Model APIs catalog. You can also set the BASETEN_API_KEY environment variable.

fields.label: Default Baseten Model
fields.description: The default model to use for Baseten requests. DeepSeek-V3 is the recommended general-purpose option. DeepSeek-R1 offers chain-of-thought reasoning. GLM-4 and Kimi K2 are also available.

fields.label: Baseten API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for Baseten API requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://inference.baseten.co/v1). Useful when proxying through your own gateway.

fields.label: Enable Z.AI Provider
fields.description: Z.AI is Zhipu AI's OpenAI-compatible GLM large language model family. GLM-5.2 features a 1M context window, tool calling, and thinking mode. GLM-5 Turbo is optimized for speed and coding tasks.

fields.label: Z.AI API Key
fields.description: Your Z.AI API key. Get one from Z.AI Platform. You can also set the ZAI_API_KEY environment variable.

fields.label: Default Z.AI Model
fields.description: The default Z.AI (GLM) model to use. GLM-5.3 is the latest with 1M context, tool calling, and reasoning (recommended). GLM-5.3 Flash is the budget tier; GLM-5.3 FlashX is the high-speed tier.

fields.label: Z.AI API Base URL (Optional)
fields.description: Custom base URL for Z.AI API requests. Leave empty to use the default (https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4). Useful for regional proxies or Z.AI-compatible endpoints.

fields.label: Google Maps API Key
fields.description: Your Google Maps Platform API key. Required for geocoding tools (address lookup, reverse geocoding, nearby places search). Get one from Google Cloud Console. You need to enable the "Geocoding API" and "Places API" for full functionality.

fields.label: Enable Embedded LLM Provider
fields.description: Run language models directly in the user's browser using WebGPU/WebAssembly. Fully private, no server resources required, no API keys needed. Models are downloaded on-demand to browser cache.

fields.label: Default Embedded Model
fields.description: Select a model for client-side inference. Models are downloaded on-demand to the user's browser cache when first used. Models marked with * support tool/function calling. Recommended: Hermes 2 Pro for best function calling accuracy.

fields.label: Active Server Model
fields.description: Select which downloaded GGUF model to use for server-side inference. Download models using the management panel below.

fields.label: Auth0 Domain
fields.description: Your Auth0 tenant domain. You can find this in your Auth0 dashboard under Settings → General (e.g., your-domain.auth0.com or your-domain.us.auth0.com for US region).

fields.label: Auth0 API Audience
fields.description: The unique identifier for your Auth0 API, configured in the Auth0 Dashboard under APIs. This is typically a URL-like identifier (e.g., https://api.yourapp.com or urn:yourapp:api).

fields.label: Required Access Scope
fields.description: Optional scope that must be present in Auth0 access tokens to use the API. Leave empty to allow any valid token. Multiple scopes can be space-separated (e.g., read:mcp write:mcp).

fields.label: Provision new accounts on first login
fields.description: Off by default. When on, a login whose identity provider asserts a verified address on a domain in this estate's verified allowlist creates an account here with viewer access. Anything else is recorded as a pending request that an administrator can approve. Without this, an unlinked subject is refused.

fields.label: Email a daily access-request digest
fields.description: On by default. Once a day, this estate's administrators receive one email naming the people who tried to sign in and were not let in, with a link to the Access requests page. Nothing is sent when no request is waiting. Turn it off if you would rather check the page yourself.

fields.label: Enable Auth0 GitHub Bridge
fields.description: Maps Auth0 GitHub identities to WordPress users for REST auditing and assistant scoping.

fields.label: Auth0 Management Client ID
fields.description: Client ID for Auth0 Management API. Required for GitHub Bridge feature to resolve user identities from GitHub accounts via Auth0.

fields.label: Auth0 Management Client Secret
fields.description: Client Secret for Auth0 Management API. Keep this secure as it grants administrative access to your Auth0 tenant.

fields.label: Enable WordPress.com/Gravatar Bridge
fields.description: Maps WordPress.com/Gravatar emails to WordPress users.

fields.label: Userinfo Endpoint
fields.description: WordPress.com userinfo endpoint URL

fields.label: Enable Simple JWT Login
fields.description: Enables bearer tokens validated by Simple JWT Login plugin to access the MCP REST API.

fields.label: Guest Token Lifetime (seconds)
fields.description: How long guest tokens remain valid. Default: 86400 (24 hours)

fields.label: Assistant Credential Lifetime (days)
fields.description: How long issued assistant credentials (identifier.secret tokens) remain valid before expiry. Set 0 for no expiry. Default: 90 days. Existing credentials without expiry are grandfathered.

fields.label: Enable REST Assistant Listing
fields.description: When enabled, authenticated API clients can retrieve the list of available assistants. Enabled by default. Disable for enhanced security if you don't need remote assistant discovery.

fields.label: Enable REST Assistant Creation
fields.description: When enabled, authenticated API clients can create new assistants remotely. Requires proper authentication (Auth0, assistant credentials, or JWT).

fields.label: Enable REST Assistant Deletion
fields.description: When enabled, authenticated API clients can delete assistants remotely. Use with caution - this is irreversible.

fields.label: Enable POST Method on SSE Endpoint
fields.description: SSE (Server-Sent Events) standard only uses GET. Enable POST only if you have LM Studio or client bugs requiring it. Leave disabled for standard SSE compliance.

fields.label: Disable Open OAuth Client Registration
fields.description: By default, the OAuth Dynamic Client Registration endpoint (RFC 7591) allows any client to register. Enable this to require manual admin approval for new OAuth clients, preventing unauthorized client registration and phishing via malicious redirect URIs.

fields.label: Require Confirmation for Destructive Tools
fields.description: When enabled, tools flagged as destructive or state-changing will require the AI client to pass confirm_destructive=true as an explicit confirmation parameter. Without this confirmation, the tool returns a preview of affected items instead of executing. Guards against accidental bulk deletion, user modification, and mass-email dispatch by AI agents.

fields.label: Enable Magic Link Sign-In
fields.description: Exposes POST /wp-json/mcp-ai/v1/magic-login/request and /confirm. Emailed links contain a hashed, single-use token that expires in 15 minutes; requests are rate-limited and answered uniformly to prevent account enumeration. Off by default.

fields.label: Magic Link App Origin
fields.description: Origin the emailed sign-in links point at — e.g. the NV oOS Complete Console address. Leave empty to use the site address.

fields.label: Enable AI Comments Moderation
fields.description: When enabled, incoming comments will be automatically analyzed by AI to detect spam, toxic content, and other moderation concerns before they are published.

fields.label: Moderation Sensitivity
fields.description: Controls how strict the AI moderation should be. Low = permissive (only flag obvious violations), Medium = balanced (flag clear issues), High = strict (flag anything questionable).

fields.label: Minimum Confidence Level
fields.description: Only apply AI recommendations when confidence is at or above this threshold. Lower values trust AI more, higher values require more certainty.

fields.label: Hold Low Confidence Comments
fields.description: When enabled, comments that AI analyzes with low confidence will be held for moderation instead of being published or marked as spam.

fields.label: Gmail OAuth Client ID
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console for Gmail integration. (Pro enables multiple connections via Remote Sites)

fields.label: Gmail OAuth Client Secret
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from Google Cloud Console. (Pro enables multiple connections via Remote Sites)

fields.label: Google Drive OAuth Client ID
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console for Google Drive integration. (Pro enables multiple connections via Remote Sites)

fields.label: Google Drive OAuth Client Secret
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from Google Cloud Console. (Pro enables multiple connections via Remote Sites)

fields.label: Google Calendar OAuth Client ID
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console for Google Calendar integration. (Pro enables multiple connections via Remote Sites)

fields.label: Google Calendar OAuth Client Secret
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from Google Cloud Console. (Pro enables multiple connections via Remote Sites)

fields.label: Permission Level
fields.description: Controls which Google Calendar permissions are requested. Changing this clears the existing authorisation — you must reconnect afterwards.

options.minimal: Minimal — plugin-owned calendar only (no Google review)
options.standard: Standard — read/write events on your calendars (Google review required)
options.full: Full — complete calendar management (Google review required)

fields.label: Default Calendar ID
fields.description: Calendar used when a tool does not specify one. Use "primary" for the account's main calendar, or paste a calendar ID from Google Calendar settings.

fields.label: Default Time Zone
fields.description: IANA time zone identifier applied to event times, for example "Europe/Zurich". Leave blank to use this site's time zone. UTC offsets such as "+02:00" are not accepted by the Calendar API.

fields.label: Crawl4AI Base URL
fields.description: Base URL for Crawl4AI service (if using external crawler).

fields.label: Crawl4AI API Key
fields.description: API key for Crawl4AI service (if required).

fields.label: Brave Search API Key
fields.description: API key for Brave Search integration. Get your API key from Brave Search API.

fields.label: Tavily API Key
fields.description: API key for Tavily Search integration (AI-first provider optimised for agent workflows). Get your API key from tavily.com.

fields.label: Mubert API Key
fields.description: API key for Mubert music generation service. Request an API key from business@mubert.com.

fields.label: Cloudflare API Token
fields.description: API token for Cloudflare integration. Create a token in your Cloudflare dashboard.

fields.label: Cloudflare Zone ID
fields.description: Your Cloudflare zone ID for cache management.

fields.label: Enable Cloudflare Pro Toolkit
fields.description: Enables AI-powered Cloudflare integration toolkit including cache purging, zone management, DNS operations, and advanced CDN features. Provides additional tools for managing Cloudflare services through AI assistants. Requires Cloudflare API Token and Zone ID to be configured. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Cloudways API Key
fields.description: API key for Cloudways hosting integration.

fields.label: Cloudways Account Email
fields.description: Email address associated with your Cloudways account.

fields.label: Cloudways Server ID
fields.description: Your Cloudways server identifier for server management operations. Find this in your Cloudways dashboard under Servers.

fields.label: Cloudways Application ID
fields.description: Your Cloudways application identifier for app-specific operations. Find this in your Cloudways dashboard under Applications.

fields.label: remove.bg API Key
fields.description: API key for remove.bg background removal service. Get your API key from remove.bg API. Note: A free tier with Python rembg is also available without an API key.

fields.label: OTLP/HTTP Endpoint
fields.description: OTLP/HTTP endpoint URL for exporting OpenTelemetry spans (e.g. http://localhost:4318/v1/traces). Leave blank to disable span export. The environment variable WP_MCP_AI_OTEL_ENDPOINT takes precedence when set.

fields.label: OTLP Bearer Token
fields.description: Optional bearer token sent in the Authorization header with each export request. Leave blank if your collector does not require authentication.

fields.label: ITA Tariff Rate API Key
fields.description: API key for International Trade Administration Tariff Rate API. Get your API key from Trade.gov Developer Portal. Used for import/export tariff information and trade compliance.

fields.label: Meta Access Token
fields.description: Long-lived access token for Meta Graph API. Used for Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp integrations.

fields.label: Meta App ID
fields.description: Your Meta (Facebook) App ID.

fields.label: Meta App Secret
fields.description: Your Meta (Facebook) App Secret.

fields.label: Meta Business Account ID
fields.description: Your Meta Business Account ID (for WhatsApp Business API).

fields.label: TikTok Access Token
fields.description: Access token for TikTok Open API with video.share scope.

fields.label: TikTok Client Key
fields.description: Client Key from TikTok developer portal.

fields.label: TikTok Client Secret
fields.description: Client Secret from TikTok developer portal.

fields.label: Plaid Client ID
fields.description: Client ID from Plaid dashboard for financial account integration. Get your credentials from Plaid Dashboard. Used for optional bank account sync in Financial Planner Toolkit.

fields.label: Plaid Secret Key
fields.description: Secret key from Plaid dashboard. Keep this secure and never share publicly.

fields.label: Plaid Environment
fields.description: Select Plaid environment: Sandbox for testing, Development for development, Production for live use.

fields.label: Enable AI Media Library
fields.description: When enabled, newly uploaded images will be automatically analyzed by AI to generate alt text and captions. This feature uses vision-capable AI models (requires OpenAI or Gemini API key).

fields.label: Generate Alt Text
fields.description: Generate descriptive alt text for images to improve accessibility for screen readers and SEO.

fields.label: Generate Captions
fields.description: Generate detailed captions for images to provide context and enhance content.

fields.label: Overwrite Existing
fields.description: When enabled, AI will overwrite any existing alt text or captions. When disabled, AI will only fill in missing metadata.

fields.label: Allowed Image MIME Types
fields.description: Comma-separated list of allowed image file extensions for AI analysis and uploads. Leave empty to use WordPress defaults. Common formats: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, svg. Current WordPress defaults:

fields.label: Allowed File MIME Types
fields.description: Comma-separated list of allowed file extensions for chat uploads and AI processing. Leave empty to use WordPress defaults. This controls what file types users can upload through chat and assistant interfaces. For security, only include file types you trust.

fields.label: Web Search Provider
fields.description: Choose the search engine to use for web search tool. DuckDuckGo is free but has rate limits. Brave Search requires an API key but offers higher limits and better results. Tavily is purpose-built for AI agents and offers the richest structured results.

fields.label: Deep Research Model
fields.description: Model used by the deep_research tool for multi-step web research and report synthesis (provider:model format, the industry-standard SMART_LLM pattern). Leave as Auto to walk the provider preference chain. Prefer long-context models: research reports need room for many sources plus synthesis.

fields.label: Enable Varnish Purge Tool
fields.description: Allows AI assistants to purge Varnish cache when making content changes. Requires Varnish HTTP cache to be configured on your server. Only enable if you have Varnish installed.

fields.label: Enable Markup Subsystem
fields.description: Master switch for the markup subsystem. When enabled, markup-aware tools such as edit_openai_image (mask), crop_image (crop) and edit_gemini_image (region) can pause the agentic loop and ask the user to draw on an image in the chat canvas. Turn this off to disable elicitation site-wide; affected tools will fall back to executing with whatever arguments the model already supplied.

fields.label: Attention Tool Routing
fields.description: When an assistant has more tools assigned than the "minimum tools" threshold below, the plugin scores all enabled tools against the conversation and sends only the most relevant ones to the model. Assistants at or below the threshold always receive their complete tool list. Turn this off to always send every enabled tool to the model.

fields.label: Minimum Tools for Routing
fields.description: Attention tool routing only activates when an assistant has more tools assigned than this number. Default 100 matches the maximum tools sent in a single chat payload. Set to 0 to always route.

fields.label: Tools to Keep When Routing
fields.description: When attention tool routing is active, this is how many of the most relevant tools are sent to the model per request. Lower values reduce token usage but may hide tools the model needs.

fields.label: Send Group Email Capability
fields.description: WordPress capability required to use the Send Group Email tool. Controls who can send bulk emails through AI assistants. Higher capabilities = more restricted access.

fields.label: Max Email Recipients
fields.description: Maximum number of recipients allowed in a single group email. Higher limits increase the risk of spam. Consider your server's email sending limits.

fields.label: Search Gmail Capability
fields.description: WordPress capability required to use the Search Gmail tool. Controls who can search Gmail messages through AI assistants. Default is Manage Options (Administrator) for security.

fields.label: Max Gmail Search Results
fields.description: Maximum number of Gmail messages that can be returned in a single search. Lower values improve performance and reduce API usage.

fields.label: Search Google Drive Capability
fields.description: WordPress capability required to use the Search Google Drive tool. Controls who can search Drive files through AI assistants. Default is Manage Options (Administrator) for security.

fields.label: Max Drive Search Results
fields.description: Maximum number of Google Drive files that can be returned in a single search. Lower values improve performance and reduce API usage.

fields.label: Mailjet API Key
fields.description: API key for Mailjet email service integration.

fields.label: Mailjet API Secret
fields.description: API secret for Mailjet email service.

fields.label: QuickBooks API Key
fields.description: API key for QuickBooks integration.

fields.label: QuickBooks Client ID
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from QuickBooks developer portal.

fields.label: QuickBooks Client Secret
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from QuickBooks developer portal.

fields.label: Google Analytics Property ID
fields.description: Google Analytics 4 Property ID (e.g., 123456789).

fields.label: Google Analytics Service Account JSON
fields.description: Service account credentials in JSON format from Google Cloud Console.

fields.label: GitHub OAuth Client ID
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from GitHub Developer Settings. Create an OAuth app at GitHub Developer Settings.

fields.label: GitHub OAuth Client Secret
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from GitHub Developer Settings.

fields.label: Enable JetEngine CCT Storage
fields.description: Use JetEngine Custom Content Types for efficient chat transcript and assistant data storage.

fields.label: Enable JetEngine AI Tools
fields.description: Activate JetEngine-specific tools for post type management, taxonomy operations, and CCT queries.

fields.label: Enable WooCommerce AI Tools
fields.description: Activate WooCommerce-specific tools for managing products, orders, and customers.

fields.label: Enable Elementor AI Widgets
fields.description: Add AI-powered chat widgets and other AI elements to Elementor page builder.

fields.label: Enable Google Site Kit Integration
fields.description: Activate Google Site Kit integration to access Analytics, Search Console, PageSpeed, and AdSense data through AI assistants. Requires Google Site Kit plugin to be installed and configured.

fields.label: Enable AI Assistant for JetEngine CPTs
fields.description: Adds an AI assistant metabox to all JetEngine custom post type edit screens. Users can get AI help with content creation, editing, and optimization. (Pro Feature)

fields.label: Enable Research & Add Pages for JetEngine CPTs
fields.description: Creates dedicated "Research & Add" pages for each JetEngine CPT. These pages provide AI-powered research and data entry interfaces, similar to toolkit Research & Add pages. The pages appear as submenu items under each CPT. (Pro Feature)

fields.label: Enable Quiz System
fields.description: Enables the quiz/assessment system for tutors. Provides 7 tools for creating quizzes, managing submissions, and grading. Includes automatic JetEngine CCT synchronization when available. Requires edit_posts capability to create quizzes. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Media Toolkit
fields.description: Enables the Media Toolkit for creating and managing reusable templates for the Graphic Editor Plus tool. Templates allow you to save operation configurations (logo positions, resize settings, AI prompts) and apply them to multiple images via AI assistants or batch operations. Requires upload_files capability. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Document Generation Toolkit
fields.description: Enables the Document Generation Toolkit with tools for creating professional documents (PDF, Word, Excel) and extracting text from scanned documents using OCR. Includes: pro_pdf, pro_word, pro_excel_document, extract_pdf_text (with auto-OCR), and ocr_pdf_text. Requires upload_files capability and Node.js with npm packages (pdfkit, docx, exceljs, tesseract.js, pdfjs-dist) installed. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Default OCR Provider
fields.description: Select the default OCR provider for extracting text from scanned PDFs and images. "Auto" tries providers in order of best accuracy: OpenAI Vision (highest accuracy, API cost), Gemini Vision (high accuracy, API cost), Ollama (local, privacy-focused), Tesseract (free, local). Individual tools can override this setting.

options.openai: OpenAI Vision (Highest accuracy, requires API key)
options.gemini: Google Gemini Vision (High accuracy, requires API key)

fields.label: Enable OCR Image Preprocessing
fields.description: Applies image preprocessing (grayscale, contrast enhancement, sharpening, noise reduction) before OCR to improve text recognition accuracy. Uses Sharp (Node.js) or Imagick (PHP). Recommended for scanned documents.

fields.label: OCR Max Pages Default
fields.description: Default maximum number of pages to process with OCR. OCR is resource-intensive; limiting pages prevents timeouts on large documents. Individual tools can override this setting. Set to 0 for unlimited (not recommended).

fields.label: Excel Version Target
fields.description: Default Excel version for formula generation. Modern (Excel 2021+/Microsoft 365) supports LAMBDA, LET, XLOOKUP, and other advanced functions. Legacy (Excel 2019 and earlier) uses traditional formulas. Excel Online supports cloud-specific features.

fields.label: Enable LAMBDA Functions
fields.description: When enabled, the Pro Excel tool can generate LAMBDA functions for custom, reusable, and recursive formulas. LAMBDA makes Excel Turing-complete, enabling advanced programming capabilities. Requires Excel 2021+ or Microsoft 365.

fields.label: Maximum Formula Complexity
fields.description: Controls the complexity level for generated formulas. Simple formulas are easier to understand and maintain. Complex formulas offer more sophisticated solutions but may be harder to debug. Advanced formulas use cutting-edge Excel features.

fields.label: Include Formula Comments
fields.description: When enabled, generated formulas include inline comments explaining each step and component. This makes formulas easier to understand and maintain, especially for complex calculations.

fields.label: Formula Optimization
fields.description: Choose how formulas are optimized. Readability prioritizes clear, maintainable code. Performance focuses on calculation speed and efficiency. Balanced provides a compromise between the two.

fields.label: Enable Project Management
fields.description: Enables AI-powered project, task, and event management. Provides 13 tools for creating, updating, listing, and deleting projects, tasks, and events. Includes automatic JetEngine CCT synchronization when available. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable AI CPT Management
fields.description: Enables AI assistant integration on WordPress custom post type edit screens (posts, pages, products, terms). Adds an AI metabox that allows you to use AI tools to help create, edit, and manage content directly from the WordPress admin interface. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Places Management
fields.description: Enables AI-powered places management for attractions, businesses, and locations. Provides 6+ tools for creating, searching, listing, and managing places with Google Maps integration. Includes geocoding, radius search, and place data enrichment. Enhances all geospatial and mapping tools. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable ECA Pro Toolkit
fields.description: Enables AI-powered Extra-Curricular Activities management for schools. Provides tools for creating and managing ECAs (clubs, societies, sports), managing student enrollments, viewing schedules, and syncing with iSAMS. Includes 5+ tools for comprehensive ECA administration. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Google Classroom ECA Integration
fields.description: Adds 12 Google Classroom tools to the ECA toolkit: course listing, roster and course sync, announcements, coursework, submissions, guardians, analytics, and push notifications. Requires a Google Classroom connection under Pro → Remote Sites. Classroom OAuth scopes are restricted: use an internal school Google Cloud project or complete Google app verification.

fields.label: Enable Health & Wellness Pro Toolkit
fields.description: Enables AI-powered health and wellness management for individuals, families, and pets. Provides 30+ tools for managing members, medical records, policies, checkups, prescriptions, and allergies. Includes secure health data storage with proper access controls. Always ensure HIPAA/GDPR compliance for healthcare deployments. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: PHI Handling Acknowledgement (Multisite)
fields.description: Required on multisite installations before the Health & Wellness and Healthcare Imaging toolkits will load. Has no effect on single-site installations. See docs/HIPAA_POSTURE.md for full data-flow and compliance documentation.

fields.label: Enable Healthcare Imaging Viewer Pro Toolkit
fields.description: Enables DICOM medical imaging viewer with Cornerstone3D. Provides secure PET/CT/MR study upload, metadata extraction, REST API integration, and HIPAA-aligned audit logging. Includes manage_imaging_studies tool for AI-powered medical image management. Always ensure HIPAA compliance for healthcare deployments. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Cloudways Pro Toolkit
fields.description: Enables AI-powered Cloudways hosting management for servers and applications. Provides 58+ tools for server management, application deployment, monitoring, security, backups, and performance optimization. Includes server operations, database management, SSL certificate management, and deployment automation. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable CRM & Email Marketing Toolkit
fields.description: Enables AI-powered CRM and email marketing toolkit with company management, contact tracking, lead management, and email campaign tools. Includes Company CPT with Research & Add page for AI-powered company research and target identification. Integrates with Newsletter and WP Mail SMTP plugins. Provides web search integration for industry analysis and best practices research. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable DietPi Pro Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 18+ AI-powered DietPi management tools for SSH command execution, service control, system monitoring, transmission torrent management, Sonarr/Radarr media automation, Jackett indexer search, and media center integration. Requires Pro addon and a DietPi device. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable E-commerce Toolkit
