fields.description: Enables 20 AI-powered e-commerce tools for product management, order processing, inventory tracking, customer segmentation, and sales analytics. Requires WooCommerce. Supports mesh network for multi-store inventory sync. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable FlowHub Toolkit
fields.description: Enables FlowHub dispensary inventory synchronization with WooCommerce. Maintains a local CCT cache so AI assistants can query inventory instantly. Provides tools for inventory search, product catalog browsing, location management, and sync control. Requires FlowHub API credentials and WooCommerce. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable EZuite Toolkit
fields.description: Enables EZuite ERP inventory synchronization with WooCommerce. Maintains a local CCT cache so AI assistants can query inventory instantly. Provides tools for inventory search, sync control, and settings management. Requires EZuite ERP API credentials and WooCommerce. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Food & Beverage Toolkit
fields.description: Enables the Food & Beverage Management toolkit: reads restaurant operating data (menu, recipes, stock, sales, covers, purchases, waste, labour, utilities, budgets, bookings) from Google Drive or CSV, computes the 21 F&B metrics (M-01…M-21) deterministically, and generates the 13 report layouts (R-01…R-13) as drafts. Outputs are drafts only — no sending, ordering or record changes. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable GTmetrix Performance Toolkit
fields.description: Enables the GTmetrix × WPCode Performance Optimization toolkit: run GTmetrix tests over the GTmetrix REST API v2.0, assess Core Web Vitals and page-weight budgets deterministically, map failing audits to WordPress fixes, and deliver them as WPCode-ready snippets or inactive WPCode drafts. Requires a GTmetrix API key. Test runs consume GTmetrix API credits within a site daily budget. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Shopify Sync Toolkit
fields.description: Enables bidirectional Shopify↔WooCommerce inventory synchronization with a local CCT cache for zero-cost bulk queries and analytics. Provides tools for synced product search, inventory tracking, sales analytics, and sync management. Complements the live Shopify API tools. Requires Shopify API credentials and WooCommerce. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Social Media Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 15 AI-powered social media tools for content calendar management, multi-platform posting, analytics, hashtag tracking, competitor analysis, and automated responses. Supports mesh network for cross-site posting. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Analytics Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 12 AI-powered analytics tools for revenue forecasting, customer segmentation, churn prediction, custom reports, and data warehouse integrations (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift). Supports mesh network for aggregated reporting. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Multilingual Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 10 AI-powered multilingual tools for content translation, language detection, RTL optimization, translation memory, quality checks, and WooCommerce product translation. Supports mesh network for shared translation memory. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Video Production Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 12 AI-powered video tools for editing, compression, format conversion, watermarking, thumbnail generation, captions, and platform optimization. Requires FFmpeg on server. Supports mesh network for distributed rendering. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Financial Planner Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 24 AI-powered financial tools for retirement planning, budget management, investment analysis, debt calculation, goal planning, and tax estimation. Includes Plaid API integration for bank account sync. EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY - Not financial advice. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Calendar Booking Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 12-15 AI-powered booking tools for appointment scheduling, calendar sync (Google/Outlook/iCloud), staff management, service offerings, availability management, and payment processing. Supports mesh network for multi-location availability. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Outbound Appointment Booking Toolkit
fields.description: Automates multi-channel outbound sequences (email, LinkedIn DMs, Instagram DMs) on top of the CRM Toolkit, with an angle bank, objection matrix, weekly A/B tests, an approval board, and booking links that route prospects into the Calendar Booking Toolkit. Requires the CRM Toolkit for leads and sequences. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable DJ Management Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 15-18 AI-powered DJ management tools for event booking, equipment inventory, playlist creation, contract generation, payment tracking, and music API integrations (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube). Includes DocuSign/HelloSign for contracts. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Image Production Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 12-15 AI-powered image tools for AI generation (DALL-E 3, Stable Diffusion), upscaling, editing, format conversion, compression, and watermarking. Supports mesh network for GPU-accelerated processing. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Comic Creation Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 12 AI-powered comic creation tools for script generation, panel breakdowns, character sheets, panel art, inking/coloring/lettering, page layouts, speech bubbles, and CBZ export. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable AI Tool Builder Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 10 AI-powered meta-tools for building new tools: scaffolding, code generation, parameter schema design, test generation, documentation, and quality assurance. Uses OpenAI Codex for intelligent tool creation. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Architect Agent Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 4 self-editing tools for AI agents: file management (read/write/list), shell command execution, git operations, and code search. Provides GitHub Copilot CLI-level capabilities for autonomous development. Requires edit_plugins capability. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Architectural Design Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 16 professional architectural tools: AI floor plan generation, space optimization, 3D modeling, photorealistic rendering, construction blueprints, code compliance checking, sustainability analysis, and cost estimation. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Site Creator Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 26 site creation tools: research & best practices (4), page builders (5), section builders (6), widget builders (4), template management (4), and Architect Agent integration (3) for automated development workflows. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Regulatory Registration Pro Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 15 regulatory registration tools for managing product registrations, compliance documents, regulatory requirements, and multi-country submissions (Sri Lanka NMRA, UAE, Saudi SFDA, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, India). This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Chat Channels Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 21 specialized tools for managing communications across Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Facebook Messenger. Provides enterprise-grade chat channel integration for unified multi-platform messaging. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Law Firm Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 62 AI-powered legal tools across five modules: Matter Management (10), Billing & Trust (10), Compliance & Ethics (9), Client & Communications (9), and Research & Analytics (9). Includes 5 custom post types (Matters, Clients, Documents, Time Entries, Trust Transactions), a shared legal calculator, and dedicated admin pages (Settings, Dashboard, Research & Add). This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable CRE Debt & Securitization Toolkit
fields.description: Enables 57 AI-powered CRE debt tools across five modules: Originations (11), Underwriting (13), CMBS/Securitization (10), Debt Fund Management (11), and Asset Management (12). Aligned with CREFC, MBA/CMB, ARGUS, CCIM, and CFA/CAIA standards. ANALYSIS ONLY - Not investment advice. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable WebChat Integration
fields.description: Enables real-time WebRTC-based video chat integration with room management, participant tracking, and anonymous chat support. Includes 6 tools for creating and managing WebChat rooms, plus message storage with JetEngine CCT support. This feature is only available in the Pro addon.

fields.label: Enable Multi-Tenant Isolation
fields.description: When enabled, all tenant-scoped custom post types (CPTs), custom database tables, and CCT caches are automatically filtered to show only the current tenant's data. The tenant context is resolved from the user's assigned tenant, an HTTP header (X-WP-MCP-AI-Tenant), or the assistant's bound tenant. When disabled, all data remains globally visible (backward-compatible default). Requires the Pro addon. See the Multi-Tenant Setup Guide for details.

fields.label: Enable Site Creator
fields.description: When enabled, AI assistants can use site creator tools to automatically install themes, plugins, update options, and create content. This feature requires manage_options capability.

fields.label: Allow Plugin Installation
fields.description: Allows AI to install and activate plugins from the WordPress.org repository. Plugins are only installed from trusted WordPress.org sources.

fields.label: Allow Theme Installation
fields.description: Allows AI to install and activate themes from the WordPress.org repository. Themes are only installed from trusted WordPress.org sources.

fields.label: Allow Option Updates
fields.description: Allows AI to update WordPress options (e.g., blogname, blogdescription) via the update_option tool.

fields.label: Allow WP-CLI Tools
fields.description: Allows AI to inspect and interact with the WP-CLI environment. This includes checking WP-CLI availability and version information.

fields.label: Allow Elementor Kit Import
fields.description: Allows AI to import Elementor template kits from the Media Library. Requires Elementor to be active.

fields.label: Mailjet From Email
fields.description: Default "from" email address for Mailjet messages. Must be a verified sender in your Mailjet account.

fields.label: Mailjet From Name
fields.description: Default "from" name for Mailjet messages.

fields.label: Mailjet Webhook Secret
fields.description: Optional secret for verifying webhook requests from Mailjet.

fields.label: Brevo API Key
fields.description: API key for Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) email marketing and CRM tools. Get this from your Brevo account under SMTP & API → API Keys. See Brevo developer docs for details.

fields.label: Brevo From Email
fields.description: Default "from" email address for Brevo messages. Must be a verified sender in your Brevo account.

fields.label: Brevo From Name
fields.description: Default "from" name for Brevo messages.

fields.label: Brevo Webhook Secret
fields.description: Optional secret for verifying webhook requests from Brevo.

fields.label: Mailgun API Key
fields.description: Private API key for Mailgun email delivery. Get it from your Mailgun dashboard under API Security. See Mailgun API reference for details.

fields.label: Mailgun Sending Domain
fields.description: Verified Mailgun sending domain (e.g. mg.example.com). Found under Sending → Domains in your Mailgun dashboard.

fields.label: Mailgun Region
fields.description: Choose the Mailgun region that matches where your domain is registered.

fields.label: Mailgun From Email
fields.description: Default "from" email address for Mailgun messages. Must use your verified Mailgun sending domain.

fields.label: Mailgun From Name
fields.description: Default "from" name for Mailgun messages.

fields.label: Google Analytics 4 Credentials JSON
fields.description: Service account JSON credentials file for Google Analytics 4 API access. Download from Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts. The JSON must be valid and contain type, project_id, private_key, and client_email fields.

fields.label: Enable Dynamic Budget Management
fields.description: Automatically allocate and adjust token budgets based on system resources and workload tier.

fields.label: Enable Predictive Optimization
fields.description: Use historical usage patterns to forecast and prevent resource exhaustion.

fields.label: Enable Capability-Based Tool Gating
fields.description: Enforce WordPress capability checks for tool access based on user roles.

fields.label: Enable Cron-Based Task Orchestration
fields.description: Allow AI agents to create and manage scheduled background tasks with inherited budget constraints.

fields.label: Enable Automatic Async Tool Execution
fields.description: Automatically execute long-running tools (video generation, image generation, etc.) asynchronously via WordPress cron to prevent PHP timeouts. When enabled, tools with "async", "long-running", or "may-timeout" capability flags will be queued immediately and return a job_id for status polling.

fields.label: Enable Capacity-Aware Tool Routing
fields.description: When enabled, the system monitors CPU, memory, and tool execution load in real-time. Tools are automatically routed to the background queue when capacity drops below safe thresholds, preventing PHP timeouts and resource exhaustion during peak usage.

fields.label: Enable Harness Evolution
fields.description: Master switch for the Continual Harness evolver. When off, the evolve_harness tool reports that evolution is disabled and no Refiner provider calls are made.

fields.label: Apply Evolved System Prompts
fields.description: When enabled, the prompt produced by the evolver replaces the assistant system prompt during chat resolution. Without this switch, evolved prompts are stored but never used.

fields.label: Expose Evolved Skills
fields.description: When enabled, skills produced by the evolver become available to assistants alongside file-based skills. Evolved skill code remains inert instructional text and is never executed.

fields.label: Hourly Evolution Budget (USD)
fields.description: Maximum provider spend per assistant per hour across all mutation paths (evolver, search, proposer, population). Set to 0 to block all evolution spend.

fields.label: Evolution Mutations Per Hour
fields.description: Maximum mutations per assistant per path per hour. Set to 0 to block all mutation attempts.

fields.label: Evolution Warmup Iterations
fields.description: Minimum iterations before the first evolution may be triggered.

fields.label: Post-Mutation Verification
fields.description: Runs a mini-evaluation of each evolved prompt on the parent failure cases and rejects non-improvers. Recommended whenever evolution is enabled.

fields.label: Enable Agent Role System
fields.description: Enable the agent role abstraction layer for multi-agent coordination. Agent roles define specialized behaviors (planning, execution, validation, domain expertise) that can be assigned to AI professions. Disabling this will hide the Agents view from the orchestration dashboard.

fields.label: Enable AI Professions
fields.description: Enable the AI professions custom post type for creating specialized AI assistants with specific roles, tools, and expertise. Professions are the deployable agents used in multi-agent workflows. Disabling this will hide the Professions view and limit multi-agent capabilities.

fields.label: Enable Multi-Agent Teams
fields.description: Enable creating teams of AI professions that work together on complex tasks. Teams allow agents with different roles (Planner, Executor, Critic) to collaborate, with automatic task delegation and result aggregation. Requires Agent Roles and Professions to be enabled.

fields.label: Enable Agent Coordination Tools
fields.description: Enable specialized tools for multi-agent coordination: create_agent_team (compose teams), delegate_to_agent (task delegation), and aggregate_agent_results (result merging). These tools allow AI assistants to orchestrate other AI assistants for complex workflows.

fields.label: Enable Chat-Client Memory
fields.description: Allow logged-in users to use the long-term memory surface in the chat client. When disabled, the memory drawer, recall, and store endpoints are suppressed site-wide regardless of per-user preferences.

fields.label: Memory Retention (Days)
fields.description: Memories older than this many days will be pruned during weekly cleanup. Set to 0 to never automatically delete memories.

fields.label: Memory Dormancy Threshold (Days)
fields.description: Memories not accessed in this many days are marked dormant. Dormant memories are deleted first when per-user caps are exceeded.

fields.label: Max Memories Per User
fields.description: Maximum number of memories a single user can store. Oldest dormant memories are deleted first when this cap is exceeded.

fields.label: Professions Default Provider
fields.description: Default AI provider for all professions. Individual professions can override this setting.

fields.label: Professions Default Model
fields.description: Default AI model for all professions (e.g., gpt-4.1, claude-sonnet-5). Leave empty to use provider default.

fields.label: Professions Default Temperature
fields.description: Default creativity/randomness setting for professions (0.0 = deterministic, 1.0 = creative). Individual professions can override.

fields.label: Teams Default Provider
fields.description: Default AI provider for all team members. Individual teams can override this setting.

fields.label: Teams Default Model
fields.description: Default AI model for all team members (e.g., gpt-4.1, claude-sonnet-5). Leave empty to use provider default.

fields.label: Teams Default Temperature
fields.description: Default creativity/randomness setting for teams (0.0 = deterministic, 1.0 = creative). Individual teams can override.

fields.label: Enable ACP Server
fields.description: When enabled, the /acp REST routes will be available and the site will advertise ACP capabilities via the .well-known/ai-peer endpoint.

fields.label: Require Tool Approval
fields.description: When enabled, dangerous tool calls initiated from an ACP client will trigger the interactive session/request_permission flow in the IDE.

fields.label: Async Tool Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for async tools (like video generation) to complete before timing out. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes). Increase this for tools that may take longer, such as high-quality video generation.

fields.label: SSE Stream Max Duration (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds before the server forces an SSE stream reconnect. Shorter durations reduce PHP-FPM worker exhaustion but cause more frequent reconnects. Default is 120 seconds (2 minutes). Set to 0 to disable forced reconnects (streams run until the client disconnects or the 30-minute hard cap).

fields.label: Cron Job History Retention
fields.description: How long to keep executed cron jobs visible in the Cron Manager after they run. This allows you to verify test jobs ran successfully and review execution history. Jobs with "Executed" status will remain visible for this period before being automatically removed.

options.0: Never - Remove immediately (not recommended for testing)

fields.label: Use TypeScript-Compiled Assets
fields.description: When enabled, the chat interface loads TypeScript-compiled assets from assets/js/dist/ instead of legacy assets/js/*.min.js files. This provides type-safe, modern ESM-based JavaScript. Requires running npm run build:js:ts first to produce the dist/ files. Disable if you encounter issues with the TypeScript build.

fields.label: Memory Warning Threshold
fields.description: Trigger warnings when memory usage exceeds this percentage (modern cloud-native standard: 70%).

fields.label: Memory Critical Threshold
fields.description: Trigger critical alerts when memory usage exceeds this percentage (modern cloud-native standard: 85%).

fields.label: Error Rate Warning Threshold
fields.description: Trigger warnings when error rate exceeds this percentage (SRE best practice: 5%).

fields.label: Error Rate Critical Threshold
fields.description: Trigger critical alerts when error rate exceeds this percentage (SRE best practice: 10%).

fields.label: High Priority Budget
fields.description: Percentage of available budget allocated to high-priority tasks.

fields.label: Medium Priority Budget
fields.description: Percentage of available budget allocated to medium-priority tasks (modern standard: 75%).

fields.label: Low Priority Budget
fields.description: Percentage of available budget allocated to low-priority tasks.

fields.label: Critical Health Budget Reduction
fields.description: Reduce budgets to this percentage when system health is critical.

fields.label: Warning Health Budget Reduction
fields.description: Reduce budgets to this percentage when system health shows warnings.

fields.label: Low Tier Context Window
fields.description: Total context window for low-tier workloads (< 128MB memory). Includes all input and output tokens. Modern AI standard: 2000 tokens.

fields.label: Medium Tier Context Window
fields.description: Total context window for medium-tier workloads (128-512MB memory). Includes all input and output tokens. Modern AI standard: 8000 tokens.

fields.label: High Tier Context Window
fields.description: Total context window for high-tier workloads (> 512MB memory). Includes all input and output tokens. Modern AI standard: 32000 tokens.

fields.label: Enable Per-Call Token Limits
fields.description: Limit the maximum number of tokens a single tool call can consume.

fields.label: Per-Call Token Limit
fields.description: Maximum tokens per individual tool call (applies to all tools unless overridden). Set to 0 for unlimited.

fields.label: Enable Per-Session Token Limits
fields.description: Limit the total number of tokens a single chat session can consume across all tool calls.

fields.label: Per-Session Token Limit
fields.description: Maximum tokens per chat session (cumulative across all tool calls). Enforcement includes a 20% safety buffer, so a session is blocked once it reaches about 80% of this value. Set to 0 for unlimited.

fields.label: Restriction Notifications
fields.description: Displays a dismissible admin notice when a user is flagged by the restriction registry. Blocked users remain visible on the Token Manager page and the Pro Command Center regardless of this setting.

fields.label: Enable Semantic Prompt Compression
fields.description: Strips unnecessary grammar, connectives, and filler words from prompts while preserving all facts, numbers, and technical terms. Reduces token usage by 20-35% with no quality loss. All facts and specific data are preserved verbatim.

fields.label: Compression Level
fields.description: Controls how aggressively prompts are compressed. Conservative preserves more original wording. Aggressive maximizes token savings.

options.1: Conservative — Remove only connectives and intensifiers (10-15% savings)
options.3: Aggressive — Maximum compression, shortest sentences (30-40% savings)

fields.label: Enable Speculative Tool Execution
fields.description: Predict tool sequences ahead of execution, verify results batch-style, and stop at first rejection. Reduces round-trips for predictable tool chains. Works with all AI providers.

fields.label: Enable Orchestration Depth Scheduling
fields.description: Automatically switch between Deep, Standard, Shallow, and Minimal verification tiers based on system capacity and prediction confidence. High load + high confidence = fast path; low confidence = thorough verification.

fields.label: Enable Hybrid Plan Generation
fields.description: Fan out complex tasks to multiple planning agents, merge their proposals, and discover parallelizable subtask groups. Improves plan quality through agent diversity.

fields.label: Enable Tiered Model Routing
fields.description: Use fast, inexpensive models for drafting and powerful models for verification. Auto-selects per provider. Saves 40-70% on API costs.

fields.label: Enable Chain Acceptance Tracking
fields.description: Records which predicted tool chains were actually accepted, feeds data back to the predictor for continuous improvement, and surfaces acceptance trends in the dashboard.

fields.label: Deep Tier — Spare Capacity Required
fields.description: Percentage of spare system capacity required before Deep verification is eligible. Default: 70%

fields.label: Standard Tier — Spare Capacity Required
fields.description: Spare capacity needed for Standard verification. Falls back to Shallow when capacity is below this. Default: 40%

fields.label: Shallow Tier — Spare Capacity Required
fields.description: Minimum spare capacity for Shallow verification. Below this, the system drops to Minimal (fastest path). Default: 15%

fields.label: High Confidence Threshold
fields.description: Prediction confidence above this level may allow skipping to a shallower tier. Default: 0.80

fields.label: Medium Confidence Threshold
fields.description: Confidence below this level triggers deeper verification when capacity allows. Default: 0.60

fields.label: Low Confidence Threshold
fields.description: Confidence below this level always escalates verification regardless of capacity. Default: 0.40

fields.label: Speculative Block Size
fields.description: Maximum number of tools to speculatively draft per block. Higher = more throughput potential, but more wasted work on rejection. Default: 4

fields.label: Speculative Minimum Acceptance Rate
fields.description: Historical acceptance rate below which speculation pauses automatically. Prevents wasting resources on poor predictions. Default: 60%

fields.label: Prediction Confidence Threshold
fields.description: Minimum confidence level required to act on predictions (modern ML standard: 40%).

fields.label: Prediction Safety Buffer
fields.description: Extra safety margin when making predictive adjustments (modern standard: 15%).

fields.label: Enable RabbitMQ Integration
fields.description: Enable message queue integration for improved agentic workflow processing.

fields.label: RabbitMQ Host
fields.description: Hostname of the RabbitMQ server. Usually "localhost" on Cloudways.

fields.label: RabbitMQ Port
fields.description: AMQP port (default: 5672).

fields.label: RabbitMQ Username
fields.description: Username for RabbitMQ authentication.

fields.label: RabbitMQ Password
fields.description: Password for RabbitMQ authentication. Check Cloudways for your credentials.

fields.label: Virtual Host
fields.description: RabbitMQ virtual host (default: /).

fields.label: Queue Prefix
fields.description: Prefix for queue names (useful for multisite).

fields.label: Enable Priority Queues
fields.description: Use separate queues for high, normal, and async priority tools.

fields.label: Enable Parallel Tool Execution
fields.description: Allow independent tools to execute in parallel during agentic workflows.

fields.label: Worker Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time for a worker to process a single tool.

fields.label: Max Retry Attempts
fields.description: Number of times to retry a failed tool execution.

fields.label: Retry Delay (ms)
fields.description: Initial delay between retries (uses exponential backoff).

fields.label: Enable Dead Letter Queue
fields.description: Store failed messages for debugging and manual processing.

fields.label: Dead Letter TTL (seconds)
fields.description: How long to keep failed messages (default: 24 hours).

fields.label: Require Authentication for All Access
fields.description: Master Security Switch: When enabled, all REST API endpoints and uploaded media files require authentication. Only logged-in users or those with valid bearer tokens can access the system. Warning: This will block guest access and public integrations.

fields.label: Allow Guest Access (with Tokens)
fields.description: When global authentication is enabled, this allows guest tokens (X-WP-MCP-AI-Guest header) to access endpoints that explicitly allow guests.

fields.label: Bypass Checks for Logged-in Users
fields.description: Logged-in WordPress users bypass additional authentication checks. Disable this to require explicit bearer tokens even for logged-in users.

fields.label: Protect Chat Endpoints
fields.description: Protects chat endpoints from unauthenticated access.

fields.label: Protect Tool Execution
fields.description: Prevents unauthenticated users from executing tools.

fields.label: Require Assistant Scope for MCP
fields.description: Fail closed: when enabled, tools/list and tools/call return 403 instead of falling back to the full tool registry when no assistant resolves (no explicit assistant_id, no token-bound assistant, no default assistant).

fields.label: Protect Assistant Management
fields.description: Protects assistant creation, reading, updating, and deletion.

fields.label: Protect Chat Transcripts
fields.description: Prevents unauthenticated access to chat history and transcripts.

fields.label: Protect File Operations
fields.description: Protects file upload and download REST endpoints.

fields.label: Protect Direct Media URLs
fields.description: Advanced: Intercepts direct media file requests and requires authentication. May impact performance. Requires rewrite rules or server configuration. See documentation for .htaccess configuration.

fields.label: Protect Attachment Pages
fields.description: Blocks unauthenticated access to WordPress attachment pages.

fields.label: Allow Public Thumbnails
fields.description: When media protection is enabled, allows public access to thumbnails (thumbnail, medium, medium_large) while protecting full-size images.

fields.label: Protected File Extensions
fields.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to protect (e.g., pdf,doc,docx,zip). Leave empty to protect all uploaded files.

fields.label: Minimum Capability Required
fields.description: Users must have at least this capability to access protected endpoints. Follows WordPress capability hierarchy.

fields.label: Enable IP Whitelist
fields.description: When enabled, only requests from whitelisted IPs can access the system. Use with caution - can lock you out if misconfigured.

fields.label: IP Whitelist
fields.description: Enter IP addresses or CIDR ranges, one per line. Supports both IPv4 and IPv6. Example: 192.168.1.100 or 10.0.0.0/24

fields.label: Enable IP Blacklist
fields.description: Blocks requests from specified IP addresses. Useful for blocking known malicious IPs or scrapers.

fields.label: IP Blacklist
fields.description: Enter IP addresses or CIDR ranges to block, one per line. Example: 203.0.113.0 or 198.51.100.0/24

fields.label: Require HTTPS for API Requests
fields.description: Enforces HTTPS (TLS 1.2+) for all REST API requests. Highly recommended for production. HTTP requests will return 403 Forbidden.

fields.label: Enable Rate Limiting
fields.description: Protects your installation from excessive API requests, brute-force attacks, and resource exhaustion. Returns HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) when limit exceeded.

fields.label: Rate Limit (requests per window)
fields.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per time window per user/IP. Recommended: 300-1000 for normal usage with AI agents.

fields.label: Rate Limit Window (seconds)
fields.description: Time window for rate limiting in seconds. Common values: 60 (1 min), 300 (5 min), 3600 (1 hour).

fields.label: Rate Limit By
fields.description: What to use for rate limit tracking. User ID is more accurate but IP-based works for unauthenticated requests.

fields.label: Max Tool Executions
fields.description: Maximum tool executions allowed per window per user/IP. Set to 0 for unlimited. Recommended: 300+ for AI agent workloads — agents can fire dozens of tool calls per minute.

fields.label: Tool Rate Limit Window (seconds)
fields.description: Time window for the tool execution limit in seconds. Common values: 60 (1 min), 300 (5 min).

fields.label: Exempt AI Agent Tokens
fields.description: Assistant credentials are an explicit grant of the tool set, and AI agents legitimately call tools in bursts. Recommended ON for agent workloads; guest and chat-UI traffic stays rate-limited.

fields.label: Enable Security Audit Log
fields.description: Records failed login attempts, IP blocks, authentication failures, and security violations. Required for SOC 2 and GDPR compliance. Useful for security monitoring and incident response.

fields.label: Log Successful Authentication
fields.description: Records all successful authentication attempts. Creates more log entries but useful for comprehensive audit trails and compliance requirements.

fields.label: Log File Access
fields.description: Records file downloads and media access including user ID, timestamp, and file path. Useful for data protection compliance.

fields.label: Audit Log Retention (days)
fields.description: Number of days to retain audit logs. Set to 0 for unlimited retention. GDPR recommends 90-180 days. SOC 2 typically requires 365 days.

fields.label: Enable Security Headers
fields.description: Enables OWASP-recommended security headers: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, etc. Protects against XSS, clickjacking, and MIME-sniffing attacks.

fields.label: Enable HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security)
fields.description: Instructs browsers to only connect via HTTPS. Warning: Only enable if you have a valid SSL certificate and HTTPS is working correctly. Misconfiguration can lock users out.

fields.label: HSTS Max Age (seconds)
fields.description: How long browsers should enforce HTTPS. Recommended: 31536000 (1 year). Start with a low value (e.g., 300) for testing.

fields.label: CSP frame-ancestors (Clickjacking Protection)
fields.description: Controls which sites can embed your content in frames/iframes. Modern replacement for X-Frame-Options.

fields.label: CORS Allow-Origin (Cross-Origin API Access)
fields.description: Controls which external domains can call the plugin REST API from browser-based clients. "Same Origin" (recommended) blocks cross-origin access except origins listed below. Use "Allow All" only if MCP clients or AI services on other domains need access.

options.star: Allow All — any domain can call the API

fields.label: CORS Allowed Origins
fields.description: Exact origins allowed to call the plugin REST API cross-origin when CORS is set to Same Origin. One origin per line (e.g. https://chat.nvoos.cloud). The site's own origin is always allowed. WordPress core reflects any Origin header on every REST response; this plugin overrides that reflection with this allowlist.

fields.label: MCP App Allowed Hosts
fields.description: Restrict which remote MCP servers assistants may connect to (SSRF protection). Enter hostnames, one per line. A leading *. matches subdomains (e.g. *.example.com). Leave empty to accept any host (not recommended). The WP_MCP_AI_MCP_APP_ALLOWED_HOSTS constant, when defined, overrides this setting.

fields.label: Enable Root Security Key
fields.description: Adds an extra layer of security for administrative operations like deleting assistants, changing critical settings, or accessing sensitive data. Acts as a "second password" for high-risk actions.

fields.label: Root Security Key
fields.description: A secure key for sensitive operations (minimum 32 characters, recommended 64+). Store this securely - it cannot be recovered if lost. Use a password manager to generate a strong key.

fields.label: Require Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
fields.description: Requires WordPress administrators to have 2FA enabled to access plugin settings. Requires a 2FA plugin like WP 2FA or similar to be installed.

fields.label: Enable Loopback/Private Network SSL Bypass
fields.description: When enabled, SSL verification is automatically disabled for requests to localhost (127.x.x.x), private IPv4 addresses (10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x), and private IPv6 addresses (fc00::/7). Necessary for local AI services like Ollama and LM Studio which typically do not have valid SSL certificates. Disable this if you have proper SSL certificates configured for your local services or want stricter security.

fields.label: Allow Private Network Requests
fields.description: WordPress blocks requests to local and private IP addresses by default for security (SSRF protection). Enable this to allow connections to local AI services (LM Studio, Ollama, etc.) running on private network addresses like 192.168.2.222:11434. Required for local AI providers on your network.

fields.label: Guest Token TTL (hours)
fields.description: Maximum lifetime for guest tokens in hours. Tokens older than this are revoked on the next request. Set 0 for the session default (24 h).

fields.label: Require JWT Validation for A2A Calls
fields.description: When enabled, the A2A dispatcher verifies a signed JWT on every sub-agent delegation. Disable only in local/dev environments.

fields.label: Require Capability Check on delegate_to_agent
fields.description: Ensures that the initiating user holds the declared capability of the target agent before the delegation is granted.

fields.label: Enable Prompt-Injection Detector
fields.description: Fires the wp_mcp_ai_prompt_injection_detected action when a suspicious pattern is found and optionally blocks the request. Tune sensitivity and action below.

options.low: Low — flag obvious jailbreak patterns only
options.high: High — strict, may produce false positives

options.flag: Flag only — log event, allow request to proceed

fields.label: Enable PII Filter
fields.description: Uses WP_MCP_AI_Pii_Filter::scrub() to find and redact emails, phone numbers, SSNs, credit-card numbers, and API key patterns.

options.request: Request only — scrub user messages before sending to model
options.response: Response only — scrub model output before returning to client

options.block: Block — return error if PII is detected

fields.label: Require Human Approval for Write Tools
fields.description: When enabled, any tool marked with the write or state-changing capability flag is held in the approval queue before execution. Configure the approval admin at NV oOS Pro → Approvals.

options.none: None — no automatic HITL (per-tool overrides still apply)

fields.label: Enable Sandbox (Dry-Run) Mode
fields.description: Useful for staging or testing. Every tool that carries the write capability flag is queued for manual approval regardless of per-tool settings. This overrides the HITL threshold above.

fields.label: Enable AI API Cost Tracking
fields.description: Monitors estimated API costs (OpenAI, Stability AI, Gemini, etc.) and enforces per-assistant budget limits. Prevents runaway spending on paid AI providers.

fields.label: Default Daily Budget (USD)
fields.description: Maximum estimated daily API spend per assistant. Set 0 for unlimited. Individual assistants can override this via their metadata.

fields.label: Default Monthly Budget (USD)
fields.description: Maximum estimated monthly API spend per assistant. Set 0 for unlimited.

fields.label: Max SSE Connections per User
fields.description: Maximum simultaneous Server-Sent Events (SSE) connections per user. Prevents resource exhaustion from too many concurrent streaming connections. Set 0 for unlimited.

fields.label: Max Request Body Size (KB)
fields.description: Maximum allowed request body size in kilobytes for chat and tool endpoints. Larger payloads are rejected with HTTP 413. Set 0 for no limit (uses PHP default).

fields.label: Max JSON Nesting Depth
fields.description: Maximum allowed nesting depth for JSON request bodies. Prevents stack exhaustion from deeply nested payloads. PHP default is 512.

fields.label: Enable Auth Rate Limiting
fields.description: Separate from general API rate limiting. Tracks failed auth attempts per IP and temporarily blocks after exceeding the threshold. Protects against credential brute-forcing on bearer token, mesh key, and Auth0 endpoints.

fields.label: Failed Auth Threshold
fields.description: Number of failed authentication attempts before the IP is temporarily blocked. Recommended: 10–20.

fields.label: Auth Rate Limit Window (seconds)
fields.description: Time window in which failed attempts are counted. Default: 300 (5 minutes).

fields.label: Rate Limit OAuth Token Endpoint
fields.description: The OAuth token and registration endpoints are publicly accessible per RFC 6749/7591. Enable this to apply rate limiting specifically to these endpoints to prevent brute-force attacks on authorization codes.

fields.label: Error Detail Level
fields.description: Controls how much internal detail is included in REST API error responses. Production sites should use "Safe" to avoid information disclosure. In Safe mode, masked errors carry a correlation reference logged to the Recent Errors view, and administrators can see full detail per request by appending ?verbose_errors=1 to a plugin REST URL.

options.safe: Safe — generic messages only (recommended for production)
options.normal: Normal — actionable errors for authenticated users

fields.label: Strip Plugin Version from Asset URLs
fields.description: Hides the plugin version number from enqueued stylesheet and script URLs. This prevents attackers from fingerprinting your plugin version via page source inspection. Does not affect WordPress core assets or other plugins. Enabling this may reduce cache-busting effectiveness during plugin updates.

fields.label: Show AI Disclosure
fields.description: Required by EU AI Act Article 50(1). Informs users they are interacting with an AI assistant at the start of every chat session.

fields.label: Disclosure Message
fields.description: Custom AI disclosure message. Leave blank for the default: "You are interacting with an AI assistant. Responses may be generated by artificial intelligence and should be reviewed for accuracy."

fields.label: Disclosure Position
fields.description: Where to display the AI disclosure notice.

fields.label: Require User Consent
fields.description: Required by EU AI Act Article 50(1). Users must acknowledge they are chatting with AI before sending their first message.

fields.label: Consent Message
fields.description: Custom consent message shown in the modal. Leave blank for the default: "This chat is powered by AI. Your messages may be processed by AI models to generate responses. By continuing, you acknowledge and consent to AI-powered interactions."

fields.label: Enable Transparency Headers
fields.description: Required by EU AI Act Article 50(2). Enables downstream tools and platforms to detect AI-generated content via machine-readable HTTP headers.

fields.label: Enable Generation Provenance Logging
fields.description: Creates a tamper-evident audit trail of all AI interactions for regulatory compliance and debugging. Each record is cryptographically linked to the previous one, forming a verifiable chain of provenance.

fields.label: Provenance Log Retention (days)
fields.description: Number of days to retain generation provenance records. Older records are automatically pruned daily.

fields.label: Recommended Default Tools per Profession
fields.description: Recommended number of default tools to assign per profession. This is a guideline for profession configuration - actual tool count can vary based on profession needs. Default: 10

fields.label: Max Memory File Size (bytes)
fields.description: Maximum file size for memory operations, in bytes. Examples: 5242880 = 5 MB, 10485760 = 10 MB, 52428800 = 50 MB.

fields.label: Auto OPcache Reset
fields.description: Automatically clears OPcache when plugin files are updated. Helps ensure code changes take effect immediately without manually clearing cache. Recommended for development environments.

fields.label: Disable Native Streaming
fields.description: When enabled, responses are fully buffered then split into chunks with delays (simulated streaming) instead of streaming token-by-token in real time. Use this if you encounter issues with real-time streaming or your server does not support long-running cURL connections.

fields.label: OOS Engine (Experimental)
fields.description: Routes chat requests through the extracted oOS/core engine instead of the legacy WordPress-specific path. This cross-platform AI orchestration engine is designed to run identically on WordPress, Laravel, and Craft CMS via hexagonal Ports & Adapters architecture. Requires PHP 8.1+. The legacy engine handles all requests when disabled.

fields.label: Enable Mesh Computing
fields.description: Allows this instance to participate in mesh computing networks for distributed AI workload processing. Automatically generates a mesh inbound API key for peer connections.

fields.label: Enable Federation
fields.description: Enables well-known endpoints (/.well-known/ai-peer, /.well-known/jwks.json) for AI peer discovery. This allows other sites to discover your site's capabilities without requiring the full directory service.

fields.label: Enable Federation Directory
fields.description: Enables the full federation directory service including AI Peers custom post type, directory REST API, and peer verification. Requires "Enable Federation" to also publish well-known endpoints for directory participants.

fields.label: Federation Regions
fields.description: Comma-separated list of geographic regions where this site operates (e.g., "us-east,us-west,eu-central"). Used for regional routing and data residency compliance.

fields.label: Federation Data Tags
fields.description: Comma-separated data classification tags (e.g., "public,internal,confidential"). Used for data governance and access control in federated operations.

fields.label: Federation QPS Limit
fields.description: Maximum queries per second (QPS) allowed for federation API requests. Prevents resource exhaustion from federated queries. Default: 5 QPS.

fields.label: Federation Burst Capacity
fields.description: Burst capacity for federation rate limiting. Allows temporary spikes above QPS limit. Default: 10.

fields.label: Federation JWKS Keys
fields.description: JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) for federation authentication. Advanced setting - only modify if implementing custom federation authentication. Must be valid JSON array of JWK objects.

fields.label: Federation Price Hints
fields.description: JSON object with pricing information for federation services. Used for cost attribution in federated AI operations. Advanced setting. Format: {"model": "gpt-4", "cost_per_1k_tokens": 0.03}

fields.label: Mesh Inbound API Key
fields.description: Auto-generated API key for receiving mesh network requests. This key is used by peer sites to authenticate inbound connections. Copy this key to configure peer sites. Key is auto-generated when mesh networking is enabled.

fields.label: Enable A2A Server
fields.description: When enabled, your site will serve an Agent Card at /.well-known/agent.json and accept A2A JSON-RPC requests at /wp-json/mcp-ai/v1/a2a. External agents can discover and communicate with your assistants.

fields.label: Exposed Assistants
fields.description: Comma-separated list of assistant post IDs to expose via A2A. Leave empty to expose the default assistant only. Each exposed assistant will have its own Agent Card.

fields.label: Enable Push Notifications
fields.description: When enabled, A2A clients can register webhook URLs to receive push notifications when tasks change state. The agent will deliver task updates via HTTP POST to registered endpoints with retry logic.

fields.label: Enable A2A Client
fields.description: When enabled, the "Delegate to A2A Agent" tool becomes available, allowing your assistants to discover and communicate with external A2A-compliant agents. This enables cross-organizational agent collaboration.

fields.label: Default Authentication Type
fields.description: Default authentication method when connecting to remote A2A agents.

fields.label: Default Auth Token / API Key
fields.description: Default authentication credential for outbound A2A requests. Can be overridden per-request by the tool.

fields.description: Units held back from the sellable quantity to absorb cross-channel sync lag. Industry guidance: 1–3 units.

fields.label: Reconciliation cadence
fields.description: Full-catalog reconciliation frequency — the safety net behind webhook sync. Active SKUs reconcile more often.
